title: GHL Specialist
description:
GoHighLevel (GHL) Specialist / Marketing Operations VA — Business Funding Domain



Location: Remote — Philippines



Hours: To be agreed; some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time required



Compensation: Based on experience. Willing to pay $3 an hour to start



About the Role



We help qualified U.S. business owners including new business owners—pursue up to $200,000 in business credit with promotional 0% APR offers. We work with banking relationships across the country and match clients with lenders based on their credit profiles.



We’re looking for a detail-oriented GoHighLevel specialist who can build, maintain, and manage the operations behind our lead-generation and booked-call funnel.



Our funnel takes prospects from an advertisement to a video sales letter, application, booking calendar, and consultation. Your work will help prospects receive the right information, arrive prepared, and move through the process smoothly.



What You’ll Do



Build and maintain GHL funnels



Build and update landing pages, application forms, calendars, and confirmation pages.



Upload videos, approved copy, and objection-handling content.



Check mobile formatting, buttons, forms, and links.



Implement qualification and routing rules provided by us.



Maintain custom fields, tags, opportunities, and pipeline stages.



Manage workflows and
 sequences



Build and maintain appointment-based workflows.



Upload, format, and personalize our pre-call
 sequences.



Configure appointment confirmations, reminders, and rescheduling messages.



Set up follow-up for applicants who don’t book, cancellations, no-shows, and prospects who haven’t purchased.



Ensure contacts stop receiving messages that no longer apply to them.



Prevent duplicate messages and overlapping automations.



Monitor failed actions, delivery issues, and workflow errors.



Keep leads and appointments organized



Review new applications and flag incomplete information.



Monitor the GHL inbox and respond using approved scripts.



Escalate questions that require the founder’s input.



Keep appointment outcomes and lead statuses accurate.



Ensure every active prospect has a clear next action.



Prepare concise prospect notes before sales calls.



Support client onboarding



Send approved agreements, onboarding instructions, and administrative reminders.



Track outstanding client information and onboarding steps.



Maintain funding application and progress trackers.



Keep client records accurate and organized.



You will administer the process. The founder handles funding recommendations, lender-matching decisions, pricing, and sales consultations.



Test, document, and report



Test the entire funnel using dummy contacts before changes go live.



Check booking, rescheduling, cancellation, reply, and unsubscribe scenarios.



Document workflows and recurring tasks with clear SOPs.



Provide brief daily updates and weekly performance reports.



Track applications, bookings, attendance, no-shows, follow-up activity, and client conversions.



Record recurring prospect objections so we can improve our
s and videos.



Required Experience



Hands-on experience building and troubleshooting GoHighLevel workflows.



Experience with GHL funnels, forms, calendars, pipelines, tags, and custom fields.



Strong written English.



Excellent attention to detail and follow-through.



Ability to troubleshoot independently and explain what went wrong.



Comfortable using Google Sheets and recording short Loom walkthroughs.



Reliable internet and a backup plan for connectivity or power interruptions.



Willingness to follow secure procedures when handling client information.



This role requires practical GHL experience. You should be able to show workflows you have built and explain how they work.



Nice to Have



Experience with VSL or booked-call funnels.



Familiarity with Jeremy Haynes’s pre-call nurturing approach.



Experience with
 deliverability, sending-domain setup, and SMS configuration.



Familiarity with Meta lead tracking and reporting.



Basic Canva or video-editing skills.



Experience supporting a financial-services or consulting business.



What Success Looks Like



Prospects receive the correct messages at the correct time.



Bookings, cancellations, and reschedules update properly.



Leads receive timely follow-up.



CRM records stay accurate.



Problems are identified and resolved promptly.



The founder can focus on consultations and clients without constantly checking the system.



How to Apply



Subject line: GHL Operations Application



Please include:



A brief summary of your GHL experience.



Screenshots or a Loom walkthrough of workflows you’ve built. Remove confidential client information.



One example of a GHL problem you diagnosed and fixed.



Your availability, including overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



Your expected hourly or monthly rate.



Your answer to this question: A prospect reschedules their consultation, but reminders still go out for the original appointment. How would you investigate and fix it?



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical test using dummy contacts. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and makes sure the system actually works.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Scaledforce

Scaledforce is a Canadian staffing company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our tea
mbers can build stable, fulfilling and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You'll be supporting the two founders of a well-established Canadian staffing and consulting firm based in Toronto. They run a highly systemised, fast-moving business, and they're the kind of leaders people want to work for: patient teachers with high standards, who invest in training, tooling, and growth for their team. They automate anything that can be automated, document their processes, and give their people the systems and support to do great work. This is a company that has kept the same right-hand EA for years at a time because they know how to set the right person up to win.



Job Overview

We're looking for a full-time, remote Executive Assistant to become the operational right hand to both founders. This is a blended role: you'll run two demanding executive calendars and inboxes and own a broad, varied administrative workload that keeps the business moving behind the scenes.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to be handed a narrow checklist and told exactly what to do all day. It's for a confident, self-managing operator who thrives on variety, builds their own systems, and stays calm when they're switching between very different tasks. The founders manage their own time down to the 15-minute block, use tools like ClickUp and Calendly, and will meet with you regularly, drip responsibilities to you as you master them, and give you SOPs to follow. The learning curve is real, and the people who succeed here lean into it rather than get overwhelmed by it.

This role starts as an executor and is built to grow. As you learn how each founder thinks, you'll take on more ownership and judgment over time.



Work Schedule

• Monday to Friday

• Aligned to Eastern Time (Toronto) business hours

• Philippine Time: approximately 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM PHT (night shift)

Please only apply if you're able to reliably work night shift long-term.



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary PHP 42,000 – 46,000 per month

Quarterly Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

Executive Support (Two Founders)

• Calendar orchestration — Manage two busy, highly structured executive calendars, protect focus time, and keep both founders' days running smoothly — coordinating across their schedules without dropping a beat.

• Inbox management — Triage and organise both inboxes, draft replies for review, and gradually take over sending on their behalf as you learn their voice and judgment.

• Meeting prep — Prepare briefing materials and agendas, and make sure both founders walk into every meeting ready.

• Proactive time management — Run their calendars proactively the way they run their own — booked, protected, colour-coded, and always a step ahead.



Administrative & Operations Support

• Documents & agreements — Prepare and execute client agreements, build and customise proposals, and produce clean, professional documents, reports, and presentations.

• Systems & filing — Own and organise a large Google Drive database so records are structured and easy to find.

• Process execution — Follow documented SOPs to the letter and build your own systems where none exist — you'll be trusted to create order, not wait for it.

• RFP & portal management — Manage the process around RFP solicitations and government portals (managing the workflow, not answering them), keeping deadlines and submissions on track.

• General admin — Own the wide range of recurring and one-off admin that comes across the founders' desks so they can stay focused on high-value work.

Sales & Business Development Support

• Lead follow-up & CRM — Support business development with lead follow-up, prospect tracking, and keeping the CRM clean and up to date.

• Scheduling — Book and coordinate business development and prospect meetings.



Qualifications

Required

• At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant or Virtual Assistant supporting a founder, CEO, or senior executive — ideally supporting more than one executive at a time

• Proven ability to manage demanding executive calendars and inboxes with discretion, structure, and good judgment

• Strong written and verbal English — you'll draft emails, documents, and correspondence on behalf of the founders daily

• Proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets)

• Experience with broad, varied admin — documents, proposals, filing, process management — not just calendar and inbox

• Highly organised and self-disciplined — you keep everything in one system, not scattered across sticky notes, notebooks, and half-used lists

• A confident, self-managing operator who can switch gears between very different tasks without getting overwhelmed

• Proactive mindset — you anticipate needs, spot problems early, and take initiative without waiting to be asked

• Comfortable working efficiently and being measured on output — you get the right work done in a reasonable amount of time

• Reliable internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace

• Able to reliably work night shift (Toronto business hours) long-term



Nice to Have

• Experience supporting two or more executives at once

• Experience with ClickUp or another project management tool (Asana, Monday, Trello)

• Familiarity with CRM tools (logging contacts, deals, and activity)

• Experience with proposals, RFPs, or agreement/contract administration

• Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and a willingness to work within an AI-first, automation-first workflow

• Background in staffing, recruiting, professional services, or consulting



Who Thrives in This Role

The founders have kept an EA in this role for years at a time when they've found the right person. Here's who that is:

• You lean into a learning curve instead of being intimidated by it — when something's new, your attitude is “I'll figure it out.”

• You thrive on variety and can switch between very different tasks in a single day without losing your footing

• You build your own systems and processes — you create order rather than wait to be handed it

• You're calm and low-drama under a full plate — you don't overthink or talk yourself out of things before you try them

• You're disciplined and organised — you manage your own time as tightly as the people you support manage theirs

• You work efficiently and take ownership — when something's in your lane, you run it without being micromanaged

• You communicate clearly and concisely — you summarise, you don't ramble

• You're a fast learner who picks up new tools, systems, and preferences quickly, and genuinely enjoy working smarter with AI and automation



Work-From-Home Requirements

• Laptop or PC with Intel i5 or equivalent

• Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download)

• Noise-cancelling headset

• Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

• Quiet, dedicated home workspace with a desk



Why Join Scaledforce

Benefits & Perks

• 13th Month Pay

• SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG

• HMO Health Insurance

• Paid Time Off + Sick Leave: 10 PTO days (accrued) + 5 sick days after probation

• Quarterly performance bonuses

• Annual salary increases based on performance

• Netflix subscription reimbursement

Career Growth

• Long-term, stable client placement with founders who invest in their people

• Clear KPIs, documented processes, and structured onboarding

• Regular coaching, training, and performance feedback

• Room to grow from executor into a broader ownership role over time

• Supportive Canadian work culture



How to Apply

Please email the following to 

• Updated resume

• Short video (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and your experience as an Executive Assistant

• Subject line: SFSS Executive Assistant – [Your Name]

Only candidates that follow the instructions above will be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will undergo:

• Initial Scaledforce screening (30 min)

• Skills and communication assessment (30 min)

• Final client interview (30 min)

title: Video Editor - Long and Short Form
description:
GENERAL PURPOSE OF JOB

Wheeler Home Concepts is a premium real estate photography and marketing company serving Delaware and the surrounding areas. We specialize in high-quality photography, video, digital media, and design services for realtors and businesses. Our reputation is built on excellence, creativity, and top-tier service.



We’re looking for a Video Editor to support our growing team with video editing, reels editing, long-form editing, ai video editing/generation, and other projects as needed. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly organized, and skilled in creative software tools.



Must provide a link to a portfolio of your work with your application. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.



Photography & Media Support

• MLS Real Estate Videos: Create cinematic style horizontal property videos for real estate..

• Photobooth Display Videos: Design and update photobooth overlays and templates, as needed.

• Reels Editing: Create short-form video content (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) using Premier Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve.

• Long-form video editing: Interviews, podcasts, etc.

• AI Video Generation/Prompting: Use AI video generation tools to help bring creative and unique ideas to life to add to our video content.

• Assist with Writing and Maintaining Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Document processes and workflows to improve efficiency.

• Organization: Maintain organized records and files of images, projects, and updates in our system.



ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• We hire for attitude and train for skill, but experience in general administrative tasks is helpful

• Must be able to work flexible hours; Ability to work with a sense of urgency when focusing on a task

• Communicate professionally in English, both verbally and in writing; comfortably interface with clients

• Ability to maintain a positive rapport with co-workers, Realtors, and clients a must

• Carry out duties in compliance with all state and federal regulations, codes and guidelines; Comply with all company policies and procedures

• Ability to perform repetitive tasks while maintaining speed of work and attention to detail without loss to production



Required Skills & Experience

• 2+ years of demonstrated experience with:

• Premier Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro (Reels/Video Editing)

• Adobe After Effects or similar motion graphics software

• Microsoft Office (Word, Excel)

• Must have a reliable computer capable of running the required applications and 4K60 video.

• Must have fast, reliable internet for remote collaboration.

• Good to excellent English skills (spoken & written) for communication, documentation, and team collaboration.

• Must be able to work 8am-Noon Monday-Saturday, Eastern Standard Time (4 hrs). There is potential for this to become a full-time job for the right candidate.



This is primarily a video editing role. Below are detailed descriptions of the skills required for this role.



--- Must-Have Skills (Absolute Needs) ---



Extreme File Organization & Project Archiving: Exceptional discipline in project folder structures, asset naming conventions, and systematic backup workflows. All raw footage, project files, assets, and final exports must be archived so any project can be re-opened instantly for client revisions.



Versatile Multi-Style Editing (Podcasts & Talking Heads): High versatility across formats—from fast-paced 9:16 short-form reels to multi-camera long-form podcast edits (multi-cam switching, speaker reframing, pacing, and audio balancing).



Multi-Project Daily Capacity & Rapid Execution: Proven ability to manage, prioritize, and deliver multiple video edits per day under tight real estate deadlines using proxy workflows, templates, keyboard shortcuts, and batch exporting.



Proactive Content Ideation & Simple Concepts: Ability to spot trending social media formats, identify viral hooks, and pitch simple, easy-to-execute content ideas that real estate agents can quickly film on camera.



Non-Linear Editing (NLE) Suite Mastery (Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve): Expert proficiency in at least one professional desktop NLE—Adobe Premiere Pro, Apple Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve—with a clean, standardized timeline and bin structure.



Manual Color Correction & Grading: Strong technical ability to manually color correct and grade footage using vectorscopes, waveform monitors, and primary/secondary color controls (e.g., Lumetri Color, DaVinci Color Page) to deliver accurate skin tones and true-to-life interior colors without relying on automated filters.



Complex Motion Captions & Typography: Mastery in creating dynamic, animated, and highly legible text overlays (word-by-word highlights, callouts, brand fonts) designed to retain viewer attention on talking-head clips.

Social Export & Encoding Standards: Thorough knowledge of optimal platform export settings (H.264/HEVC, optimal bitrates, frame rates, color spaces) to ensure fast rendering and crystal-clear playback across all major platforms.



Speed Ramping, Motion Tracking & Masking: Advanced technical proficiency in speed ramping (smooth velocity curves for walkthroughs and transitions), motion tracking (attaching captions, callouts, or graphics to moving subjects), and masking (custom reveals, subject isolation, and targeted color adjustments).



Professional Sound Design & Multi-Track Audio Mixing: Expert ability to clean up low-quality audio, remove room echoes/reverb, balance multi-mic podcast setups, level agent vocals against background tracks, and layer subtle sound effects (swooshes, impacts, risers, ambient fills) to make videos feel polished and high-energy.



Advanced AI Prompting & Standout Creative Generation: Proven ability to craft highly specific, sophisticated text, image, and video prompts across generative AI platforms (e.g., video diffusion, generative fill, expansion tools) to create unique, high-end visual effects, cinematic property extensions, and signature styles that stand out from standard AI templates.



--- Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred Extras) ---



CapCut Desktop Proficiency: Ability to leverage CapCut Desktop for ultra-fast social edits, trending audio syncs, or rapid template builds when same-day turnaround is needed.



Motion Graphics (After Effects or Apple Motion): Experience creating or customizing lower thirds, animated property stats, transition overlays, or reusable graphics templates.



Real Estate Content Familiarity: Pre-existing understanding of property walkthrough flow, architectural framing, and real estate social media marketing trends.



All candidates offered an interview will need to perform a test edit and complete a color accuracy test.

Please do not contact me outside of OnlineJobs

title: Verification of Benefits (VOB) Representative – Behavioral Health
description:
**Company:** Claimwise Billing Solutions  

**Position:** Verification of Benefits (VOB) Representative  

**Industry:** Behavioral Health / Medical Billing



Claimwise Billing Solutions is looking for an experienced **Verification of Benefits (VOB) Representative** to join our team.



We provide billing and revenue cycle management services for **mental health (MH) and substance use disorder (SUD) providers and facilities** across multiple levels of care, including:



- Office Visits / Outpatient Services

- Outpatient (OP)

- Intensive Outpatient (IOP)

- Partial Hospitalization (PHP)

- Residential Treatment (RTC)

- Detox



### Primary Responsibilities



The VOB Representative will be responsible for verifying a patient's insurance benefits before admission or treatment. Responsibilities include:



- Contacting insurance companies to verify active coverage and behavioral health benefits

- Determining in-network and out-of-network benefits

- Verifying deductibles, copays, coinsurance, and out-of-pocket maximums

- Checking whether authorization or pre-certification is required

- Verifying coverage for specific levels of care and services

- Identifying behavioral health carve-outs and third-party administrators

- Using insurance payer portals to obtain eligibility and benefit information

- Calling insurance companies when portal information is unavailable or incomplete

- Accurately documenting benefit information for our clients and internal teams

- Communicating clearly with authorization and billing staff when additional follow-up is needed



### Required Qualifications



**Previous experience verifying insurance benefits is required.**



Applicants should also have:



- Experience calling insurance companies and speaking with payer representatives

- Experience using insurance portals such as Availity and other payer-specific portals

- Strong verbal English skills, as this position requires frequent phone calls with U.S. insurance companies

- Strong written English and documentation skills

- Good attention to detail and the ability to accurately record complex insurance benefit information

- Ability to work independently and follow established VOB procedures

- Reliable computer and internet access



### Preferred Experience



Experience with **mental health and substance use disorder insurance benefits** is strongly preferred, particularly experience verifying benefits for:



- Detox

- Residential Treatment

- PHP

- IOP

- Outpatient behavioral health services



Understanding behavioral health authorization requirements, carve-outs, and different levels of care would be a significant advantage.



### Additional Advantage



Experience with **insurance claim follow-up, claim status, denials, or accounts receivable (A/R)** is also a plus.



This is not required for the VOB position, but candidates who have experience with both **Verification of Benefits and claim follow-up** may have opportunities to take on additional responsibilities as the position grows.



### What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is experienced, dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable communicating with insurance companies throughout the day.



When applying, please briefly describe:



1. How many years of VOB or insurance verification experience you have

2. What types of insurance plans you have worked with

3. Whether you have experience with behavioral health, mental health, or substance use disorder benefits

4. Which insurance portals you have used

5. Whether you have experience with claim follow-up or insurance A/R

description:
Job Description:



We are a growing US-based executive search and recruiting firm specializing in the Heavy Civil, Manufacturing, and MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) construction industries. We connect elite talent (Project Managers, Estimators, Engineers, and Plant Managers) with top-tier industrial and contracting companies across the United States.



We are seeking a seasoned, high-stamina Outbound BPO Veteran to join our team as an Inside Sales and Lead Generation Specialist. You will not be selling low-ticket software or consumer products; you will be calling high-level industrial decision-makers to set appointments for the agency owner.



This is a full-time, long-term career opportunity operating on a permanent US Night Shift (Eastern/Central Time Zone).



Key Responsibilities:

• High-Volume Outbound Outreach: Execute 100+ cold calls per day targeting US manufacturing plant managers, operations directors, and mechanical contractors.

• Appointment Setting: Overcome gatekeepers, pitch our recruiting/staffing solutions, and schedule qualified discovery meetings for the agency owner.

• Data Validation: Update our CRM with accurate contact details, direct dial numbers, and tracking notes during your shift.

• Candidate Scripting (Secondary): Occasionally call potential job candidates to verify their current employment status and gauge their openness to new career opportunities.



Required Qualifications & Experience:

• BPO Voice Mastery: Minimum of 2 to 3+ years of solid outbound cold calling experience in a high-volume BPO environment specifically targeting US business clients (B2B).

• Industry Knowledge (Highly Preferred): Prior experience making calls into the US Manufacturing, Industrial Supply, Logistics/Freight, or MEP Construction sectors. You must know what words like "HVAC," "Piping," "CNC Machining," and "Estimator" mean.

• Flawless Communication: A highly professional, warm, and neutral English speaking voice with natural conversational confidence. You must be able to think on your feet without relying purely on a script.

• Thick Skin & Grit: A proven track record of handling high-rejection environments with a positive attitude.

Technical & Workspace Requirements:

• Hardware: A dedicated, modern laptop or desktop PC (Core i5 or higher, minimum 8GB RAM).

• Audio Equipment: A high-quality USB headset equipped with active hardware noise-canceling capabilities (to completely block out background ambient noise).

• Internet Power: A reliable, high-speed fiber internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps symmetric download/upload), plus a verified mobile data or secondary ISP backup.

• Power Redundancy: A functional power bank or mini-UPS backup setup for your router and laptop to ensure continuous uptime during local power flickers.

• Environment: A completely quiet, isolated home office space strictly free from family, pet, or traffic disruptions during shift hours.



Compensation & Perks:

• Competitive Base Salary: Negotiable based on your verifiable outbound call track record (paid bi-weekly via Wise).

• Uncapped Performance Bonuses: Generous cash incentives paid for every qualified appointment that successfully holds, plus massive milestone cash bonuses when your leads convert into a closed placement fee.

• 13th-Month Pay: Fully included annually for top-performing team members.



🚨 HOW TO APPLY (CRITICAL SCREENING STEP):

To ensure you possess high attention to detail, applications that do not follow these three exact steps will be immediately archived without review:

1. Submit your updated resume outlining your specific US outbound BPO calling history.

2. Provide a screenshot of your live internet speed test from Speedtest.net.

3. Go to 
 (or use a Loom video link) and record a 60-second audio clip. Introduce yourself, summarize your experience calling US businesses, and explain how you confidently handle a busy executive who tells you, "I don't have time for this, click." Include the link to your recording directly in your application text.

TYPE OF WORK

HOURS PER WEEK

Role: Bookkeeper: UK based clients



Bookkeeper / Accounts Assistant (Remote)



LDM Accounting Services Ltd is a growing UK accountancy firm established in 2025. We’re looking for an organised, reliable bookkeeper who can take ownership of day-to-day work for a portfolio of small business clients and grow with the firm.

Most of our bookkeeping is completed in Xero, with occasional work in Excel. We mainly use Xero Tax for accounts, corporation tax and self-assessment returns, and sometimes use TaxCalc. You’ll work directly with Luke, so clear communication, attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines independently are essential.



Key responsibilities



• Maintain accurate bookkeeping records for a portfolio of UK clients in Xero.

• Process and reconcile bank transactions, invoices, receipts and other supporting documents using Xero Documents and Hubdoc.

• Identify missing information, unusual transactions and reconciliation differences, and raise queries clearly.

• Prepare bookkeeping records for quarterly VAT returns and assist with VAT return preparation.

• Use Excel where needed to analyse transactions, reconcile balances or prepare supporting schedules.

• Keep client work up to date and communicate progress and outstanding queries.



Depending on your experience, the role may also include preparing draft year-end accounts, corporation tax returns and self-assessment returns using Xero Tax or TaxCalc, as well as assisting with payroll journals and confirmation statements.



Essential experience and skills



• At least 5 years’ UK bookkeeping experience, including at least 3 years using Xero.

• Confident using Xero Documents or Hubdoc to process invoices and receipts.

• Sound understanding of UK VAT and the ability to recognise when a transaction needs further review.

• Strong reconciliation skills and excellent attention to detail.

• Clear written and verbal English, including the ability to explain client queries simply.

• Ability to organise your own workload, meet deadlines and work independently from home.

• Reliable internet connection and a suitable home office setup.



Experience preparing accounts or tax returns in Xero Tax or TaxCalc would be an advantage, but is not essential if your bookkeeping experience is strong.



To apply



Please submit:



1. A personalised message describing your UK bookkeeping experience, the types of clients you’ve worked with and your experience using Xero.

3. Your availability for an interview over the next seven days.

title: Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant
description:
Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant

Full-Time | Work From Home | Australian Accounting Experience Required



About the Role



We are seeking a strong, commercially minded and highly organised Internal Finance Manager / Senior Management Accountant to take ownership of the internal finance function for a growing Australian group of businesses.

This is a hands-on, all-rounder accounting role. You will be responsible for the complete finance cycle — from day-to-day transactions and reconciliations through to month-end close, management reporting, budgeting, cash flow forecasting, job costing, profitability analysis and KPI reporting.



You will also take ownership of important group financial administration, including insurance, licences and other renewals, and provide confidential financial support to the Founder.

This is not a purely transactional bookkeeping role, nor is it a position for someone who only reviews work prepared by others.

We need someone who can personally get into the detail, make sure the numbers are right, analyse what they mean and give management clear financial visibility.



You will work closely with the Founder and management team and play an important role in improving profitability, cash flow, financial controls and decision-making across the Group.



Key Responsibilities



1. Day-to-Day Accounting & Finance

Take ownership of the day-to-day internal accounting function across multiple entities, including:

• Bank and credit card reconciliations

• Accounts payable and accounts receivable oversight

• Payroll and payroll-related reconciliations

• Intercompany transactions and reconciliations

• Balance sheet reconciliations

• Fixed asset and accounting schedules

• Correct transaction coding and supporting documentation

• Investigation and correction of accounting discrepancies

• Maintenance of accurate and up-to-date financial records

• Identification of unusual transactions, errors and control weaknesses



You will be expected to remain hands-on and capable of completing detailed accounting work yourself when required.



2. Month-End Closing & Management Accounts



Take full ownership of the month-end process, including:

• Month-end journals

• Accruals and prepayments

• Payroll reconciliations

• Balance sheet reconciliations

• Intercompany reconciliations

• Revenue and expense cut-off

• Review of P&L and balance sheet

• Investigation of unusual movements

• Preparation of management accounts

• Month-end management commentary

• Ensuring reporting is completed accurately and on time

The successful candidate should be capable of independently driving month-end close without needing to be reminded of each task.



3. Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow

• Prepare and maintain annual budgets

• Maintain rolling forecasts

• Prepare and maintain a rolling cash flow forecast

• Monitor actual results against budget

• Analyse and explain material variances

• Identify upcoming cash requirements and potential cash flow risks

• Monitor working capital

• Provide management with early warning of potential financial issues

• Recommend practical actions based on financial results



4. Job Costing & Profitability Analysis



A major responsibility of this role is to establish strong visibility over profitability across the Group.

This includes:

• Gross profit by client

• Gross profit by employee

• Gross profit by team/division

• Gross profit by business entity

• Client revenue versus labour cost

• Actual hours/cost versus client budget

• Employee utilisation and productivity

• Revenue and cost per employee

• Identification of underperforming clients, jobs or service areas

• Identification of scope creep and cost overruns

• Development and continuous improvement of job costing methodologies

• Recommendations to improve margins and operational efficiency



The successful candidate must be able to go beyond producing numbers and explain what the numbers mean, why performance has changed and what management should investigate or change.



5. KPI Dashboard & Performance Reporting

Take ownership of the financial KPI and management reporting framework across the Group.

Responsibilities include:

• Develop and maintain management KPI dashboards

• Ensure KPI data is accurate, reconciled and supported by reliable source data

• Monitor revenue, gross profit and GP%

• Monitor profitability by client, employee, team and business entity

• Monitor client budget versus actual hours/cost

• Monitor employee utilisation and productivity

• Track budget versus actual performance

• Monitor cash flow and working capital

• Monitor accounts receivable and overdue debts

• Maintain historical KPI trends

• Identify adverse trends and exceptions requiring management attention

• Investigate the underlying causes of financial underperformance

• Provide concise management commentary and recommendations

• Continuously improve and automate KPI reporting where practical



The objective is to give management timely, accurate and actionable visibility over the financial health and performance of the Group.



This position is expected to highlight problems proactively rather than simply produce reports.



6. Group Finance & Corporate Administration



Take ownership of important recurring financial and administrative obligations, including:

• Insurance renewals

• Professional and business licence renewals

• Registrations and other recurring compliance renewals

• Finance and loan documentation

• Subscription and contract renewals

• Maintaining a centralised renewal and compliance calendar

• Ensuring deadlines are identified well in advance

• Obtaining information and quotations where required

• Maintaining appropriate supporting documentation

• Escalating matters requiring management approval



An important expectation of this position is that key financial and administrative obligations are proactively managed without relying on the Founder to remember or continually follow them up.



7. Founder / Personal Finance Support



Provide highly confidential financial and administrative support to the Founder, including:

• Personal cash flow and financial reporting

• Investment and property-related accounting records

• Loan and finance schedules

• Personal financial administration

• Coordination of information required for tax and financial planning

• Maintaining accurate records across personal and business financial matters

A very high level of confidentiality, integrity and discretion is essential.



8. Systems, Automation & Continuous Improvement

• Improve finance processes, controls and reporting systems

• Reduce unnecessary manual work

• Identify opportunities for automation

• Use technology and AI appropriately to improve finance efficiency

• Ensure automated reports and processes remain accurate and properly controlled

• Document important finance processes

• Build scalable finance systems capable of supporting continued Group growth



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is an experienced all-rounder accountant who can work confidently from detailed transactions through to management-level financial analysis.



You should have:

• Degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent

• CPA/CA qualification or progress towards qualification highly regarded

• Strong Australian accounting experience

• Strong management accounting experience

• Demonstrated experience independently completing month-end close

• Budgeting and cash flow forecasting experience

• Strong job costing and profitability analysis skills

• Advanced Excel skills

• Strong Xero experience

• Excellent reconciliation and problem-solving skills

• Experience working across multiple entities

• Strong attention to detail

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Excellent organisational and deadline-management skills

• High level of confidentiality and professional judgement

• Ability to work independently with limited supervision



The Person We Want



We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions

• Is naturally organised and follows matters through to completion

• Notices when numbers do not make sense and investigates why

• Can move comfortably between detailed accounting and commercial analysis

• Is willing to remain hands-on

• Can prioritise effectively in a fast-moving environment

• Builds systems and controls rather than repeatedly fixing the same problems

• Is proactive about upcoming deadlines and financial risks

• Communicates issues early rather than waiting until they become urgent

• Can respectfully challenge numbers, assumptions and processes

• Looks continuously for opportunities to automate and improve finance processes

• Understands that good internal finance is not simply about producing accounts — it is about giving management visibility, control and actionable information



Key Measures of Success



Success in this position will include:

• Accurate and timely month-end closing

• Reliable management accounts

• Fully reconciled balance sheet accounts

• Reliable budget versus actual reporting

• Accurate and regularly maintained cash flow forecasting

• Clear visibility of gross profit by client, employee, team and business area

• Reliable KPI dashboards

• Early identification and escalation of financial risks

• Strong accounts receivable and working capital visibility

• No missed insurance, licence or important renewal deadlines

• Improved finance processes, controls and automation

• Reduced reliance on the Founder for routine finance administration and follow-up



The Opportunity



This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of the internal finance function of a growing Australian business group.

For the right person, the position has significant potential to develop into a broader finance leadership role as the Group continues to grow.

title: Video Editor
description:
ABOUT US



We are a European e-commerce brand selling premium cookware (titanium pans). We run paid ads on
 and Instagram every day, and video is what makes or breaks our business. We are looking for one or two editors to become our go-to people for ad creative. Not someone who just cuts clips, but someone who can build a complete ad from scratch.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Build full ad videos from scratch: hook, script, voice-over, visuals, captions, pacing, music

- Create the voice-overs for our ads. These must be in Norwegian and must sound like a natural, well-spoken native speaker. You generate these with AI voice tools. We do not want your own voice in our ads.

- Create new on-screen text and captions that actually sell, not just subtitle

- Generate new visuals and b-roll with AI tools when we do not have footage

- Produce VSL-style ads (longer, script-driven: problem, solution, offer)

- Research competitors and winning ads in the
 Ad Library and turn what you find into new angles for us

- Re-edit winning ads into new variations and new angles

- Deliver in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1 where needed



REQUIREMENTS - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



- Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience editing video ads. Not wedding videos, not YouTube vlogs, but direct-response ads.

- Strong with VSL videos and VSL scripts. You understand hooks, retention, pacing and CTA structure.

- CapCut. You work in it daily and know it inside out.

- Higgsfield. Hands-on experience generating AI video and image assets.

- Claude. This is the AI we work with. You use Claude to write scripts, hooks and angles, and you know how to prompt it properly. Other AI tools do not replace this for us.

- Able to produce clean, natural-sounding Norwegian AI voice-overs. We do not use the editor's own voice.

-
 Ad Library. You actively use it to research what competitors are running, to spot winning ads and to pull inspiration from them.

- Real e-commerce understanding. You know how a product ad is supposed to look and feel, what a winning ad looks like, and why one video converts and another does not. We want you to send a red apple emoji with your application so we know you read the full post. Without it we skip the application.

- Good written English and reliable daily communication

- Stable internet and your own computer capable of editing



If you do not have all of the above, we are honestly not the right fit for you and we will not be able to move forward. We are hiring 1 to 2 strong editors, not five average ones.



PAY AND GROWTH



- $6 to $7 per hour to start, depending on your experience and the quality of your sample work

- Your rate goes up as your self-edited videos start performing

- Real bonuses when your ads win. If a video you made and edited yourself drives sales, you get paid for it. Good work is actually rewarded here, not just praised.

- Long-term position. We are building a small, fixed creative team of one or two editors, not rotating freelancers.



HOW TO APPLY



Send me a message here on OnlineJobs with:



1. The emoji described above in the requirements section

2. One edited video ad for a titanium pan. Your own edit, your own hook, your own on-screen text, and a Norwegian AI voice-over (not your own voice). Make it look like something we could run tomorrow. You can pull product footage and images from anywhere online, or generate them.

3. A short note: your experience, the tools you work in, and your available hours per week

4. Two or three examples of ad videos you edited before, with one line on the result if you know it



Applications without the sample titanium pan video will not be reviewed.

We are looking for an experienced WordPress developer with strong expertise in Elementor and the Hello Elementor theme to help improve and maintain an existing professional website.



This is not a complete website redesign



Our website is already built in WordPress using Elementor and Hello Elementor. We want someone who can work within the existing design, improve the site, clean up unnecessary complexity, and make sure our team can continue editing the website in Elementor.

You should have strong experience with:



- WordPress

- Elementor

- Hello Elementor theme

- Responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile

- Troubleshooting Elementor layouts

- Plugin troubleshooting and cleanup

- CSS troubleshooting

- Website performance and organization



We want to simplify the site where possible.



Over time, different plugins, Elementor add-ons, custom CSS, and other solutions have been added to the website. Some may overlap or no longer be necessary.



We want someone who can determine what is actually needed rather than simply adding more plugins or custom code.

- Minimal unnecessary custom CSS

 what could safely be removed?

title: Civil Engineer – MUST Be Proficient in BOTH AutoCAD & Golden Software Surfer
description:
We are a structural engineering firm based in Texas, USA, specializing in residential foundation evaluations and are looking for an experienced civil engineer or engineering professional to join our production team.



Applicants MUST be proficient in AutoCAD, Golden Software Surfer, and written and spoken English. Please do not apply unless you meet all three requirements.



Because our company and clients are based in Texas, strong written and spoken English is required. You must be able to understand technical instructions, communicate effectively with our U.S.-based team, and work with English-language engineering reports and documentation.



This is not simply a CAD drafting position. The individual will be involved in multiple aspects of our engineering report production process, including AutoCAD drafting, Surfer modeling, Microsoft Excel calculations, data processing, and report preparation.



Primary Responsibilities



(1) AutoCAD Architectural Floor Plans

Converting field sketches into accurate residential floor plans using AutoCAD

Plotting foundation elevation measurement locations and corresponding data

Maintaining consistent drawing standards and layouts

Preparing drawings and graphics for incorporation into engineering reports



(2) Golden Software Surfer

Using the floor plan and elevation data, you will also be responsible for producing:

2D color contour/heat maps

Topographic-style foundation elevation maps

3D surface models of the residential foundation

Professional engineering graphics that clearly illustrate elevation differences and movement patterns

The Surfer models must accurately correspond with the AutoCAD floor plan and actual measurement locations.



(3) Microsoft Excel & Engineering Calculations

You will also work extensively with Microsoft Excel and will be responsible for:

Entering and organizing field data

Preparing and processing engineering calculations using established company procedures

Reviewing data for completeness and consistency

Maintaining calculation spreadsheets and standardized templates

Preparing calculation results for incorporation into engineering reports



(4) Engineering Report Production

You will work alongside other members of our production team in preparing engineering reports.

Responsibilities may include:

Organizing field data and photographs

Preparing drawings, calculations, tables, and graphics

Incorporating engineering information into established report templates

Assisting with report preparation and quality control

Coordinating with other production team members to complete reports accurately and efficiently



Production Environment

This is a production-oriented engineering environment where both accuracy and efficiency are important. We need someone who can follow an established workflow, produce consistently accurate work, and collaborate effectively with other members of the production team.



Different team members contribute to various portions of the final engineering report, so communication, organization, and attention to detail are essential.



Required Skills

Applicants must be proficient in:

AutoCAD

Golden Software Surfer

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Word

Creating residential or building floor plans

Working with XYZ/elevation data

Gridding and interpolation

2D contour and color relief/heat maps

3D surface modeling

Technical calculations and data processing

Reading and interpreting field sketches and engineering information

Preparing accurate, professional technical documents



Experience with civil engineering, structural engineering, surveying, topographic mapping, geotechnical engineering, residential foundations, or building elevation surveys is strongly preferred.



When Applying

title: Experienced Bookkeeper for a German Company - One-Time Backlog Project (Fixed Price)
description:
We are a small German limited company (a "UG") that sells online services. Our bookkeeping for 2026 has fallen behind and we need one careful person to clear the backlog. This is a ONE-TIME project with a fixed price, not an ongoing position. If it goes well, there may be a few hours of monthly work afterwards, but please apply for the project as described.



*** YOU MUST BE AN EXPERIENCED BOOKKEEPER ***

We need someone who has done real bookkeeping for real companies for years: bank reconciliation, matching receipts, VAT, payment-provider payouts. The software we use is German (DATEV Unternehmen online). You do NOT need to know it - we will show you exactly how it works on a call, it is simple. The receipts are mostly in German, but the layout is standard (date, supplier, net, VAT, total) and a translator handles the rest. Experience with German or European (VAT) bookkeeping is a big plus, not a requirement.



THE BACKLOG (January 2026 to today)



1) MATCH RECEIPTS TO THE BANK

- Go through every transaction on our business bank account for 2026

- Match each one to its receipt or invoice

- Give us a clear list of every transaction that has no document



2) COLLECT THE MISSING RECEIPTS

- Download missing invoices from supplier portals and from our
 (phone, software subscriptions, online tools and so on)

- For anything only we can get, send us one clear list - not twenty separate messages



3) UPLOAD, CATEGORISE AND BOOK IN DATEV UNTERNEHMEN ONLINE

- Upload every document to DATEV Unternehmen online and assign it to the right bank transaction

- Add the right category, VAT rate and a short note where the purpose is not obvious

- We show you how the software works first. Flag anything unclear for our tax advisor instead of guessing



4) THE INCOME SIDE

- Reconcile payouts from Stripe, PayPal and our other payment provider against the bank account

- Sort the customer sales behind those payouts (gross, fees, net, country of the customer) so the tax advisor can book them correctly

- Tell us where an outgoing invoice is missing



WHAT YOU GET FROM US

- Read-only access to the bank transactions (export or viewer access - you will never be able to move money)

- Access to DATEV Unternehmen online

- The receipts we already have, sorted by month

- Exports from Stripe and PayPal

- Fast answers. We reply the same day.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- Several years of real bookkeeping experience (bank reconciliation, accounts payable, VAT or sales tax)

- Experience reconciling Stripe and PayPal payouts

- You learn new software quickly. We train you on DATEV Unternehmen online

- Comfortable working with receipts in another language (German) using a translator where needed

- Extremely careful. One wrong VAT code is worse than a slow job

- Trustworthy. You will see company financial data and will sign a confidentiality agreement

- Big plus: experience with German or other European companies (VAT, reverse charge), or with DATEV, Lexoffice or sevDesk



THE DETAILS

- One-time project, fixed price. Tell us your price in the application

- Payment: a small PAID test first (one month of the backlog). Then 50% at the start of the main work and 50% when everything is uploaded and the missing-documents list is delivered

- Work whatever hours you like. We care about the result and the deadline you commit to

- Start as soon as possible



HOW TO APPLY - PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Answer all 7 points below, in this order. Applications that skip a point will not be read. Please do not send a generic cover letter.



1. Start your message with the words "clean books" so we know you read this.



2. YOUR BOOKKEEPING EXPERIENCE: how many years, what kind of companies (type of business and country is enough, no names needed), and exactly what you did for them.



3. SOFTWARE AND EUROPE: which bookkeeping software you have used, and whether you have ever worked for a German or European company or with VAT. If not, say so plainly - it is not a requirement.



4. You are matching receipts to the bank and find 25 bank transactions with no receipt at all. What do you do, and in what order? (2-3 sentences)



5. A Stripe payout of 1,843.20 EUR arrives in the bank account. Explain in 2-3 sentences why you cannot simply book it as 1,843.20 EUR of revenue, and what you need to book it correctly.



6. YOUR PRICE AND TIMING: your fixed price in USD for the project, assuming fewer than 300 bank transactions for the year, and how many days you need. If you cannot quote without seeing the data, give your price for the paid test month and your price per 100 transactions.



7. Your OnlineJobs profile or CV, plus one sentence on which part of it is most relevant to this project.



Everyone who follows all 7 steps gets a reply.
salary: Fixed price - quote in your application

title: Amazon FBA - Online Arbitrage / Wholesale Assistant
description:
Remote Amazon Sourcing & Operations Assistant

Remote | Part-Time or Full-Time | Some UK Hours Required



Who We Are

We run a growing UK Amazon seller business with a strong track record and an expanding product range, spanning Online Arbitrage (OA) and wholesale. Our sourcing is methodical and driven by data, and we're building a skilled, dependable remote team. If you're an experienced Amazon professional looking for a role with room to progress, we'd like to hear from you.



About the Role

You'll find profitable products to resell on Amazon, working to clear, firm sourcing criteria, and support the daily running of the business, from inventory and shipments to supplier follow-ups and customer queries. It's a role with real responsibility, suited to someone who takes ownership of their work and keeps their standards high.



What You'll Be Doing

  Sourcing and Listings

- Finding profitable OA and wholesale opportunities using Keepa, SellerAMP and other approved tools

- Reviewing sales rank history, pricing trends, Buy Box activity and competitor levels

- Checking ROI, estimated monthly sales and competition against our criteria

- Logging each lead in our internal tracker with full supporting data

- Reaching the daily lead target agreed with the team

- Adjusting prices on live products as needed

   Customer and Account Support

- Responding to customer
s

- Reviewing and claiming reimbursements

- Maintaining prep sheets

- Following up with suppliers on outstanding invoices

   Inventory and Shipments

- Keeping track of stock levels

- Setting up and creating shipments

   Team Communication

- Giving team leads clear, timely updates on findings and any issues

- Keeping on top of Amazon policy changes that affect sourcing



What You'll Need

- Proven hands-on experience with SellerAMP and Keepa

- Previous experience working with Amazon FBA and Seller Central

- A demonstrable record of sourcing profitable OA and/or wholesale products

- Solid understanding of Buy Box mechanics, and of how IP complaints and hazmat flags can rule out a lead

- Excellent written English for customer correspondence

- Strong organisational skills and confidence with Google Sheets or Excel

- Dependable internet and your own laptop or PC that runs browser extensions smoothly

- Ability to cover some UK working hours

Bonus skills: Tactical Arbitrage, BrickSeek or similar tools; knowledge of ungating and restricted categories; experience following SOPs within a VA team.



*Two-Week Probation*

Every new team member starts with a two-week probation period, during which we'll look at:

- How accurate and well-documented your leads are against our criteria

- Whether you consistently hit your daily output

- How clearly and promptly you communicate

- Your reliability and attention to detail

- Team leads will give you feedback along the way, and your place in the role is confirmed once you complete the probation successfully.



** Zero Tolerance Lead Policy! **

We operate a strict zero tolerance policy on lead integrity. Every lead you submit must be one you found yourself using approved methods. Using leads from shared lists, paid lead groups,
 groups or any third-party lead service is strictly forbidden and will result in immediate termination. We carry out verification checks, and any lead found on a publicly shared list will be flagged.



What You'll Get

- Competitive pay based on your experience and results (to be discussed at interview)

- A flexible, fully remote working arrangement

- Clear expectations and regular feedback

- Genuine opportunities to progress

- Bonuses linked to consistent, high-quality lead submissions

- A stable, long-term role within a professional team



The Person We're After

You have a solid background in Amazon sourcing and operations, and you're also a strong fit for how we work:

- Experienced: a proven track record with Amazon sourcing and operations

- Meticulous: in sourcing, small errors can be expensive

- Self-driven: you meet your daily targets without needing close supervision

- Honest and open in everything you do

- Dependable: you show up consistently, hit deadlines and communicate proactively

- Ambitious: you want to grow with the business



Please don't apply if you:

- Use, or plan to use, shared lead lists or lead groups

- Aren't willing to complete the two-week probation

- Can't commit to consistent daily output

- Aren't comfortable following strict sourcing criteria and SOPs

- Lack hands-on experience with Keepa and SellerAMP



How to Apply

To show you've read this far, add "Orange" to your application title. 

Then send us:

- A short introduction covering you and your background

- Your experience with Amazon FBA, Keepa and SellerAMP (how long you've used them, and whether you'd rate yourself intermediate or advanced)

- Your availability (hours per day, days per week, and the UK hours you can cover)

- Your expected pay rate or range

- An example of a sourcing decision you've made, with your reasoning

- Three leads you sourced in the past 7 days, each including the ASIN, source store/URL, buy cost, Amazon selling price, estimated ROI, and a Keepa screenshot or link (Only UK Amazon/Leads)

- A video of no more than 60 seconds telling us why you'd be a great fit for this role (a link is fine, for example Loom, Google Drive or an unlisted YouTube video, as long as we can view it without requesting access)



We can't review applications that are missing any of the above, and videos longer than 60 seconds may not be watched in full.



This is a remote position. Serious applicants only.



Many thanks for your time and we look forward to seeing your Applications!

## About the Position



Fitness Machine Technicians is looking for an extremely organized and detail-oriented **Parts & Procurement Coordinator** to manage the parts process for our fitness equipment repair operations.



Our technicians repair commercial and residential fitness equipment including treadmills, ellipticals, exercise bikes, strength equipment and other fitness machines.



When a technician determines that a machine needs a part, your responsibility is to make sure that part is properly identified, sourced, ordered, tracked and documented so the repair can be completed as quickly as possible.



This is a critical operations position. A technician cannot complete a repair if the correct part does not arrive.



We need someone who takes ownership and does not allow parts requests, orders, returns or refunds to fall through the cracks.



## Primary Responsibilities



### Parts Research & Sourcing



Research parts using:



- Manufacturer websites

- Parts diagrams

- Equipment model numbers

- Equipment serial numbers

- Vendor websites

- Service manuals

- Previous orders

- Manufacturer technical support

-
 and phone communication with vendors



Identify the correct part number whenever possible.



When information is missing, proactively contact the technician or vendor to obtain what is needed.



### Request Vendor Quotes



Contact manufacturers and vendors to determine:



- Part availability

- Part number

- Price

- Shipping cost

- Estimated delivery time

- Warranty status

- Alternative suppliers when appropriate



Compare vendors when appropriate to obtain competitive pricing and reasonable delivery times.



### Prepare Parts Information



Accurately document:



- Equipment manufacturer

- Model

- Serial number

- Part number

- Part description

- Vendor

- Cost

- Selling price when applicable

- Shipping

- Lead time

- Warranty information

- Order status



### Order Approved Parts



Once a part is approved for purchase:



- Place the order promptly.

- Verify the correct part number.

- Verify quantity.

- Verify shipping address.

- Verify pricing.

- Save the order confirmation.

- Record the order in our tracking system.



### Track Every Order



Every open parts order must have a known status.



You will monitor:



**Requested → Sourcing → Quote/Approval → Ordered → Shipped → Delivered → Ready for Scheduling**



You are expected to proactively identify orders that are delayed rather than waiting for someone to ask where the part is.



### Tracking Numbers



Obtain tracking information from vendors and update our systems promptly.



If tracking has not been provided within the expected timeframe, follow up with the vendor.



### Backorders & Delays



Monitor backordered and delayed parts.



Contact vendors for updated ETAs and investigate alternative suppliers when appropriate.



Notify the operations team when delays may affect a customer.



### Returns / RMA



Manage parts that need to be returned because they are:



- Incorrect

- Defective

- Damaged

- No longer needed

- Covered by warranty



Obtain RMA authorization when required and track the return until completed.



### Refund Tracking



A return is not complete simply because the part was shipped back.



You will track expected refunds and credits until the money or vendor credit has actually been received.



Outstanding refunds must be actively followed up.



### Warranty Parts



Assist with manufacturer warranty claims and required documentation.



Ensure warranty parts are ordered and tracked correctly.



### Documentation



Maintain accurate information in our systems, including ServiceMinder, Trello,
, vendor portals and spreadsheets.



Every parts request should clearly show:



- Current status

- What has already been done

- What we are waiting for

- Who is responsible for the next step

- Next follow-up date



## Performance Standards



We are looking for someone who works with urgency.



Our initial performance targets include:



**Parts sourcing:** Target completion within 40 business hours.



**Approved parts ordering:** Target order placement within 24 business hours.



**Tracking:** Orders should not remain without appropriate tracking/status follow-up.



**Returns and refunds:** Every open RMA/refund must be monitored until resolved.



Performance will also be measured on:



- Accuracy of parts ordered

- Number of parts requests completed

- Sourcing turnaround time

- Ordering turnaround time

- Outstanding orders

- Vendor follow-up

- RMA completion

- Refund recovery

- Documentation accuracy

- Number of mistakes/reorders caused by incorrect ordering



## Who We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



- Extremely organized

- Detail-oriented

- Persistent

- Comfortable researching technical information

- Good at Google searches and online research

- Comfortable calling and
ing vendors

- Strong written English

- Comfortable speaking English

- Able to manage many open tasks simultaneously

- Good with spreadsheets

- Comfortable learning new software

- Able to follow SOPs

- Proactive about problems

- Comfortable asking questions when information is missing

- Accountable for mistakes

- Able to work independently



Experience with any of the following is highly desirable:



- Procurement

- Purchasing

- Automotive parts

- HVAC parts

- Appliance parts

- Fitness equipment

- Industrial equipment

- Equipment repair

- Maintenance companies

- Inventory management

- Warranty claims

- Vendor management



You do **not** need previous fitness equipment experience if you are an excellent researcher and willing to learn.



## Software



You should be comfortable learning and working with:



- Gmail

- Google Sheets

- Google Drive

- Trello

- Service management/CRM software

- Manufacturer websites

- Vendor portals



## Application Instructions



Please provide:



1. Your resume.

2. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

3. A short description of your purchasing, procurement or parts experience.

4. The systems/software you have previously used.

5. Your experience working with vendors.

6. Your experience handling purchase orders, returns or refunds.



### Skills Test



Please answer the following:



A technician sends you this message:



> "Life Fitness treadmill needs a drive belt."



That is all the information you receive.



Explain **step-by-step what you would do before ordering the part.**



Then answer:



A vendor says a part was delivered, but the technician says they never received it.



Explain **exactly how you would investigate and resolve the problem.**



Finally, begin your application with the words:



**PARTS READY**



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be considered.
