title: VA | Operations & Business Support Specialist
description:
About Culture One



Culture One is a Diversity, Inclusion, Neurodiversity and Wellbeing consultancy, working with organisations to create more inclusive, human-centred workplace cultures through training, consulting and partnership programmes. 



The business is founder-led and moving from its early solo-founder stage into active growth across client delivery, partnerships, learning and advisory services.



This role is being created to strengthen the operational backbone of the business and reduce the amount of day-to-day coordination and administration sitting with the founder.





The Role at a Glance

This is not an entry-level VA position.

We need an experienced and proactive operations and founder-support professional who is highly reliable, organised, and who takes ownership of the day-to-day running of their role end to end. Someone who improves how things get done, not just someone who executes a task list.



The role combines hands-on operational support with improving how recurring work is organised.





Why This Role Exists



Culture One is run by a single founder who is now splitting her time between delivery, sales, and a growing partnership pipeline. Admin and operations currently sit with her, and that no longer scales. We need someone trustworthy enough to take real ownership of that side of the business, so the founder's time goes back into value driven work. 





Hours & Working Structure



• Commitment: 20 hours per week, ongoing, part-time.

• Schedule: Ideally split across the working week (around 4 hours/day) rather than compressed into one or two full days – several responsibilities need same-day attention.

• Time zone: Fully remote. The role is largely asynchronous, but the person should be comfortable with some regular overlap with Irish working hours (typically 08:00–16:00 Irish time) for check-ins and time-sensitive items. Please tell us in your application what shift pattern you would propose.





Core Responsibilities



Inbox, Calendar and follow-up management

• Triage and organise the Culture One inbox.

• Identify priorities and required actions.

• Draft or progress routine correspondence within agreed parameters.

• Maintain follow-ups so
s and commitments are not lost.

• Manage calendar and scheduling administration.

• Surface founder decisions clearly when input is required.



Operational coordination and process improvement

• Maintain a reliable operating view of open, completed, blocked and upcoming work.

• Own recurring administrative processes without needing to be reminded each cycle.

• Create and maintain practical SOPs and checklists.

• Notice gaps, duplication or inefficient processes and recommend improvements.

• Anticipate recurring work and upcoming deadlines.

• Maintain the industry events and speaking-opportunity tracker, proactively researching and adding relevant items.

• Take on research and other defined operational projects as needed.



Digital organisation and Microsoft 365

• Keep SharePoint, Teams and business files structured, current and easy to navigate.

• Maintain consistent naming, filing and version-control practices.

• Help Culture One make better use of its Microsoft 365 environment.

• Maintain professional consistency across documents and presentations using Culture One templates.



Invoicing, bookkeeping and accounts administration

• Prepare and issue invoices, maintain accurate bookkeeping records, and follow up on overdue payments.

•  Keep accounts records accurate and up to date.



CRM and opportunity administration

• Keep CRM records accurate and current.

• Maintain next actions and follow-up dates for prospects, clients and partners.

• Identify overdue follow-ups and prepare the next step.

• Support light business-development and partnership administration, without responsibility for sales closing.



Content administration

• Maintain the content calendar and publishing workflow.

• Coordinate assets, scheduling and publishing.

• Keep content files and supporting materials organised.

• Make basic updates to the Culture One’s Squarespace website as needed.

• Manage uploads and basic admin on the video/LMS platform (e.g. subtitles, organisation).

• Flag missing information or assets before they create delays.





What We Are Looking For



Essential

• At least three years' relevant experience in operations, executive support or senior virtual support.

• Experience working directly with a founder, small-business owner or senior leader.

• Evidence of independently managing work rather than relying on daily task assignment.

• Exceptional organisation, reliability and follow-through.

• Strong attention to detail and quality control.

• Experience building or maintaining operating processes, trackers or SOPs.

• Confident use of Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Experience coordinating content or social-media administration.

• Comfortable working in a small, growing business where not every process is already built.



Strong advantage

• SharePoint organisation or administration.

• CRM management.

• Professional-services or consultancy experience.

• Experience using AI tools effectively within business workflows.





Tools & Systems



ALREADY COMFORTABLE WITH:

• Microsoft 365: Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams and SharePoint, used at a genuinely strong level. Someone who can organise and improve how we use the Microsoft 365 environment is a real plus.

• Canva: For design and content assets.

• Calendly: Managing discovery call bookings from the website.

• Squarespace: Our website platform – enough familiarity to make edits/updates and continue to upskill to maximise our website and hosting platform.



HAPPY TO TRAIN ON:

• Xero or Quickbooks: Our accounts platform, this is being newly set up. General bookkeeping/accounts software experience is a plus but not required.

• Video / LMS platform: We're moving off Vimeo onto a new video hosting or LMS-style platform for training content. This means learning to upload content, add subtitles, and handle basic admin.





We value people who:

• Value different working styles – we don't all work the same in the same way.

• Close loops – follow work through to completion and confirm when it is done.

• Notice when something has been missed.

• Bring a recommendation where possible, rather than simply presenting a problem.

• Ask good questions when judgement is genuinely required.

• Challenge inefficient ways of working constructively.

• Take responsibility for the quality of their work.

• Communicate early when something is blocked.

This is a strengths-based role. We value curiosity, problem-solving and a learning mindset, and we will support you to build new skills while making the most of the strengths you already bring.





Skills Profile

We're looking for genuine strength across most of the areas above, backed by real examples – not a generalist who is only lightly familiar with each. That said, if you are strong across the majority of this brief but have a gap in one or two specific areas, say so honestly in your application. We would rather hire a strong, self-aware operator and support their development in an area than hire someone who is learning across the board.



What Success Looks Like

• First 30 days: Core systems and workflows are understood; inbox, invoicing, scheduling and routine admin are being run independently and reliably.

• First 60 days: Recurring work no longer needs to be assigned manually – open actions are visible, issues are flagged early, and practical process improvements are being proposed.

• First 90 days: Follow-ups are controlled, recurring processes run consistently, and the role is actively reducing operational dependency on the founder with minimal oversight needed on the basics.



Application & Selection Process

• 1. Application: CV/profile plus a short note on your operations and administration experience, and what shift pattern you could offer.

• 2. Interview: A competency-based interview about your experience and working style. 

• 3. Reference checks: We contact at least two previous clients or employers directly, with a focus on reliability and follow-through.

• 4. Offer: Start with a defined 30/60/90-day check-in plan (see 'What Success Looks Like' above).

title: Team Lead / Senior Technical QA — Architecture, BIM, or Construction Delivery Background
description:
# Team Lead / Senior Technical QA — Architecture, BIM, or Construction Delivery Background



**NOTES: Must be available to start Oct 1st**



**Remote | Philippines | Full-Time Contractor**



Oliant is looking for a strong **Team Lead / Senior Technical QA** professional in the Philippines to lead a growing remote team supporting construction technology, AI-assisted workflows, data quality, and project delivery.



This is not a basic QA role. We are looking for someone who understands construction drawings, project delivery, technical coordination, and quality standards — and who can lead a team with structure, patience, accountability, and strong communication.



The ideal candidate may come from an **Architecture, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, BIM, construction coordination, or technical QA** background.



## About the Role



As a **Team Lead / Senior Technical QA**, you will manage a team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists working across multiple projects. Your main responsibility is to ensure that the team produces accurate, timely, and high-quality work.



You will review project outputs, guide team members, identify quality issues, improve delivery processes, and act as the first escalation point when something needs clarification or correction.



This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining technical construction knowledge with people leadership, quality control, and process improvement.



## What You’ll Do



Your responsibilities will include:



* Lead a team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists.

* Own the quality, accuracy, and timeliness of the team’s deliverables.

* Review work before it reaches the client or senior stakeholders.

* Ensure data accuracy, reporting consistency, and adherence to project standards.

* Help team members interpret construction drawings, 3D models, markups, RFIs, redlines, comments, and other technical documents.

* Support weekly workload planning and help assign team members based on project needs, skill level, and capacity.

* Maintain internal trackers, project status updates, and delivery documentation.

* Provide structured feedback to team members.

* Train junior team members on workflows, drawing interpretation, QA standards, platform usage, and delivery expectations.

* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.

* Escalate blockers, risks, and quality concerns early.

* Coordinate with other remote teams involved in project setup, configuration, mapping, QA, and delivery.

* Participate in client-facing or internal stakeholder meetings when needed.

* Help create a culture of ownership, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.



## What We’re Looking For



You should apply if you have:



* A Bachelor’s degree in **Architecture, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering**, or a related construction / technical field.

* Strong ability to read and interpret construction drawings, including architectural plans, sections, MEP layouts, structural drawings, fit-out details, and site-related documentation.

* Experience with BIM, construction coordination, project delivery, technical QA, or quality control.

* Experience reviewing technical work for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to catch mistakes before they become client-facing issues.

* Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.

* Experience leading, mentoring, training, or coordinating other team members.

* Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently in a remote environment.

* Confidence working with spreadsheets, trackers, reports, and structured project data.

* Ability to learn new tools, platforms, and workflows quickly.



## Helpful Experience



The following experience is helpful, but not all are required:



* Autodesk Revit

* AutoCAD

* Navisworks / NWD model navigation

* BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud

* Bluebeam

* Procore

* Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel

* Primavera P6 or ASTA Powerproject

* Construction progress tracking

* QA process design

* Data validation

* AI-assisted workflows

* Remote team leadership



## Who You Are



We are looking for someone who is:



* Detail-oriented and quality-driven.

* Calm under pressure.

* Clear and respectful when giving feedback.

* Comfortable holding people accountable without micromanaging.

* Proactive in raising risks, blockers, and process gaps.

* Able to explain complex technical issues in simple terms.

* Fair, patient, and supportive with junior team members.

* Comfortable working with changing priorities.

* Interested in technology, AI, construction data, and modern digital workflows.



## Compensation



* **Starting compensation:** **$950 – $1,100 USD/month**, depending on experience and interview performance.

* **Strong candidates with proven leadership, BIM, construction coordination, or QA management experience may be considered up to:** **$1,200 USD/month**.

* Compensation is reviewed based on performance, reliability, quality of work, leadership, communication, and business needs.



This is a full-time contractor role. Weekend or rest-day work may be required depending on project needs and will be handled separately according to the project schedule and applicable rate structure.



## Role Details



* **Location:** Fully remote, Philippines

* **Type:** Full-time contractor

* **Schedule:** Full-time

* **Seniority:** Lead / Senior Technical QA

* **Reports to:** Delivery / Operations Management

* **Team:** You will help lead a growing team of junior technical QA associates and delivery specialists.



## Why Join Oliant?



Oliant works with international clients and remote teams across multiple regions. We are building specialized teams around AI-assisted QA, technical validation, construction data, digital workflows, and project delivery.



This is a strong opportunity for someone who wants to move beyond individual production work and grow into a leadership role where quality, communication, process improvement, and team development matter.



You will help shape how the team works, how quality is maintained, and how junior technical talent grows.



## How to Apply



Please send your resume and a short introduction that includes:



1. Your background in Architecture, Engineering, BIM, construction coordination, or QA.

2. The tools you have used, such as Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, BIM 360, Procore, Bluebeam, Excel, or similar platforms.

3. Your experience reviewing drawings, models, reports, or technical project data.

4. Any experience leading, mentoring, training, or coordinating team members.

5. Your expected monthly compensation in USD.



We are looking for someone who can lead with quality, ownership, and good judgment. If that sounds like you, we would be happy to hear from you.

A few months ago, we were at ~$150k/month.



Then ~$300k.



Then ~$600k+.



We’re building toward $1M, $2M, $3M+/month and beyond.



But retention?



It’s basically untouched.



We have:



* 35,000+ existing
 profiles

 revenue today

* Almost no live flows

* No serious
 capture system

* No subscription engine

* No systematic replenishment

* No winback engine

* No real cross-sell system



In other words:



You won’t inherit a retention machine. You’ll build it.



Your mission



Build retention into a major profit center for the company.



 is the first mission.



But we’re not looking for someone whose ambition ends at sending campaigns and optimizing Klaviyo flows.



We want someone who thinks about the entire customer lifecycle:



How do we turn more first-time buyers into second-time buyers?



How do we increase customer LTV?



When should each customer hear from us?



What should we sell them next?



When should we replenish?



Which customers should receive which offer?



Where should we capture more
s?



Should we introduce subscriptions?



Where does SMS make sense?



How do we generate more incremental contribution profit from the customers we already paid to acquire?



That’s the job.



What you’ll own



You’ll have end-to-end ownership of retention, starting with:



*
 strategy

*
 copywriting

* Campaigns

* Lifecycle flows

* Segmentation

* Deliverability

* List growth and capture strategy

* Post-purchase

* Cross-sells

* Replenishment

* Winback

* Customer reactivation

* Product affinity

* Customer cohorts

* LTV analysis

* Retention offers

* Subscription strategy

* SMS where appropriate

* Retention analytics and attribution

* Testing and experimentation



You’ll also work closely with paid acquisition and CRO so retention isn’t treated as an isolated channel.



You can challenge offers, discounts, bundles, pricing presentation, subscriptions, gifts and other commercial decisions.



If you need design or technical resources, we’ll provide them.



If you’re capable of executing something yourself, even better.



We move extremely fast



This is important.



We’re not looking for someone who needs their first 30 days to perform an audit, create a strategy deck and prepare a roadmap.



You’ll obviously analyze the business.



But you’ll analyze while shipping.



If you join Monday, we expect meaningful retention infrastructure to start going live within days.



We have a strong bias toward action:



Launch → measure → learn → iterate → scale.



We’d rather run intelligent experiments and learn from real customers than spend weeks debating hypothetical optimizations.



Who we’re looking for



You are a hands-on retention operator.



You’ve personally built and scaled
/lifecycle systems for serious e-commerce businesses.



You’re an excellent direct-response copywriter.



You understand customer psychology, offers and merchandising—not just
 software.



You’re highly analytical.



You understand LTV, repeat purchase rate, cohort behavior, contribution margin and incrementality.



You understand deliverability deeply enough to own it.



You can work inside Klaviyo or similar platforms without relying on other people for basic execution.



You’re comfortable with Shopify.



You know how to build flows, segments, campaigns and automations yourself.



You understand how
 interacts with Meta, Google, CRO and the broader customer journey.



You experiment relentlessly.



You’re autonomous.



You move fast.



And when something breaks, your first instinct is to investigate and solve it—not wait for someone else.



Builder > Manager



We’re specifically looking for someone who enjoys zero-to-one environments.



If your strength is managing a large CRM team and delegating execution, this probably isn’t the right role today.



Initially, you’ll be hands-on.



You’ll write.



You’ll build.



You’ll launch.



You’ll analyze.



You’ll experiment.



You’ll figure things out.



But if you build the function successfully, we don’t expect you to remain a solo operator forever.



You’ll have the opportunity to hire people underneath you and grow into Head of Retention / Lifecycle across our brands.



Our environment



We’re a small, ambitious, highly autonomous team.



We’re fully remote.



We operate internationally across dozens of markets and languages.



We work primarily asynchronously.



We don’t believe in recurring meetings for the sake of meetings.



You’ll have direct access to the CEO and significant freedom to operate.



Our localization infrastructure allows us to adapt and deploy content across markets quickly.



We sell across several consumer categories, including health, supplements, pet and home products.



New products and markets are launched constantly.



Speed matters here.



Ownership matters more.



What success looks like



We’re starting from almost zero, so the initial opportunity is enormous.



Your first objective is to establish the retention fundamentals quickly and start generating meaningful incremental revenue and profit.



From there, we want you to systematically increase:



* Repeat purchase rate

* Customer LTV

* Incremental contribution profit

* Revenue per customer

* Cross-sell penetration

* List size and quality

* Replenishment

* Reactivation

* Subscription adoption where appropriate



Long term, we believe retention can become one of the company’s largest profit levers.



We care about actual business growth—not making an attribution dashboard look good.



Compensation



We’re flexible for the right person.



The package will include:



* Strong fixed compensation

* Meaningful performance-based upside

* Significant growth in responsibility and compensation as the function scales



If you build retention into a major profit center, there is a clear path toward leading the function and building your own team.



We’re optimizing for exceptional talent, not the cheapest candidate.



How to apply



Don’t send us a generic cover letter.

 marketers wouldn’t have thought to run.

 infrastructure

track shops over time with the Meta Ad Library and spy tools (WinningHunter, TrendTrack or similar);

research in depth before calling a product "worth it": does it work, who buys it, monthly revenue, recurring revenue, competitors, what could kill it;

check the smaller markets (Poland, Italy, Spain, France, Belgium, Switzerland) for products nobody sells there yet;

keep a precise sheet: only products with proof of scale or real capacity to scale, every number with its link, and a clear verdict (worth it, watch, skip).

Categories: supplements, health and comfort devices, accessories, wearables. No general stores, no clothing with many sizes.



About us



We are an e-commerce company based in Switzerland, running our own brands in Europe since 2020. What you find, we launch, and we show you the results.



Working hours



You work on Swiss time: Monday to Friday, inside 9 am to 6 pm CET (about 4 pm to 1 am in Manila), around 4 hours a day at fixed times. No quota: we look at how much ground you cover and how exact your data is. (To show us you read this description, type the number 29 in the reading-check field of the form.)



Requirements



1-At least 1 year of paid product research for a dropshipping or e-commerce brand.

2-Daily use of the Meta Ad Library and at least one spy tool.

3-A research sheet or tracker you built yourself that you can show us.

4-Clear English. Fast and exact: when you don't know, you write "not verified".



This job is NOT for you if



you are looking for your first research job. We train you on our method, not on the craft;

your research starts on TikTok "viral" lists or AliExpress best-sellers;

you let an AI tool write your research. We click every link;

you cannot work Swiss hours, 20 hours a week, for at least six months.

What we offer



Paid every week, on time. Tools paid by us.

Your research gets launched, and you get feedback from people who run the ads.

No daily calls, no screen tracker. One long-term researcher, not a pool.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
ELLSEY Creative is looking for an experienced Graphic Designer to join our creative team, working across a diverse portfolio of brands, industries and creative projects.



We’re looking for a designer with strong creative judgement who can understand what needs to be communicated, who it needs to connect with, and develop the right creative response. Someone who can work within established brands while still bringing fresh thinking to the work, and who cares about the details that separate good design from great design.



This is a hands-on creative role for someone who can think independently, work confidently at pace, take ownership of their work, and consistently deliver to a high standard.





Role focus:



As a Graphic Designer at ELLSEY Creative, you’ll work across a broad range of client brands and design requirements, from everyday content through to campaigns, publications and larger creative projects. You won’t simply be implementing layouts or waiting for someone else to determine the creative direction. We expect our designers to think. 



You should be able to understand the content, audience and objective, determine how it should be communicated visually, and carry that thinking through to the finished work. You’ll need to move confidently between different brands and styles without allowing your own personal design style to dictate every outcome.





Key responsibilities:



Develop creative concepts and visual directions across client projects

Design high-quality digital and print assets across multiple brands

Create campaign creative, social media assets, EDM graphics, presentations, documents, publications, marketing collateral and other brand materials

Take supplied content and determine the strongest way to communicate it visually

Apply and extend established brand identities across different formats and applications

Translate complex or content-heavy information into clear, visually engaging design

Create strong layouts with considered hierarchy, typography, composition and use of imagery

Source, select and work with imagery and visual assets appropriate to each brand and project

Prepare artwork correctly for digital and print production

Maintain consistency and attention to detail across every deliverable

Manage multiple projects, brands and deadlines without compromising the quality of the work

Take ownership of design outcomes from initial concept through to final artwork





Design capability:



You are highly proficient across the Adobe Creative Suite, particularly:



InDesign

Illustrator

Photoshop



You have strong foundations in typography, layout, composition, colour, visual hierarchy and brand application.



You understand that strong design is not simply about making something look good. It needs to communicate clearly, support the objective and feel right for the brand and audience. You can work within an established brand system without becoming constrained by it. You know how to create variety, develop new ideas and keep creative fresh while maintaining the integrity of the brand.





How you think:



- You bring ideas to the table

- You can look at content, understand what it is trying to communicate and determine how it should come to life visually. You don’t need every creative decision made for you before you can begin.

- You notice when something feels off. You care about proportion, spacing, typography, hierarchy and the small details that affect the overall quality of a design.

- You are comfortable receiving feedback, but you also have enough experience and creative judgement to explain your decisions and contribute your own perspective.

- Most importantly, you understand that working across multiple client brands requires versatility. Great design for one client may be completely wrong for another.





Working at ELLSEY Creative:



ELLSEY Creative is a fast-moving creative environment. You’ll work across multiple clients, projects and priorities, often moving between very different brands and styles throughout the day.



You need to be comfortable working at pace. Priorities can shift, deadlines can be tight, and several projects may be moving at the same time. You can adapt quickly, stay organised and keep a clear head without allowing speed or pressure to compromise the standard of your work.



You’ll work with a high level of autonomy and ownership. We expect you to manage your workload, communicate early when something needs attention, meet deadlines and maintain our creative standards without needing constant direction.



We care about both quality and momentum. Great work matters, but so does being able to deliver it efficiently.





Highly regarded but not necessary:



Creative direction or senior-level design experience

Brand development and visual identity design

Website and digital design

UX/UI and an understanding of digital user experience

Motion graphics or animation, including After Effects

Video editing

Long-form documents, publications and information-heavy design





What matters:



This role suits someone who:

- Has strong creative instincts and excellent design fundamentals

- Produces work that feels considered rather than templated

- Can think conceptually as well as execute

- Works quickly and efficiently without sacrificing attention to detail

- Is comfortable managing multiple priorities and tight deadlines

- Remains focused and solutions-oriented when things get busy

- Can move quickly between very different brands and visual styles

- Takes ownership rather than waiting for constant direction

- Has exceptional attention to detail

- Cares deeply about the standard of the finished work



We’re looking for someone who wants to contribute creatively and take responsibility for the quality of what leaves the studio.





Remuneration:  



Pay rate is dependent on experience and demonstrated capability.





Applicants:



Please provide links to recent work. Please do not include work created with AI.

Please only apply via Online Jobs, those who
 directly outside the platform will not be considered.

This is not a basic virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who is highly organized, proactive, comfortable making decisions, and capable of managing a constantly changing production schedule without needing to be told what to do every step of the way.



You will work remotely but will be responsible for coordinating U.S.-based subcontractor crews, customers, schedules, field staff, and production systems. This is a key operational role within the company, and we are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of the business.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Schedule projects and coordinate job starts

• Coordinate subcontractor crews and maintain an accurate production schedule

• Create, send, and manage work orders

• Recruit, screen, and onboard new subcontractors

• Maintain an active subcontractor roster and track availability

• Continuously build a strong pipeline of qualified subcontractors

• Make sure we have enough production capacity for upcoming work

• Monitor projects from scheduling through completion

• Solve day-to-day production and scheduling problems

• Communicate with subcontractors, customers, salespeople, and field staff

• Keep our CRM accurate and up to date

• Track project status, delays, issues, and completion

• Coordinate warranty work, punch-list items, and smaller service projects

• Coordinate with U.S.-based field staff and help ensure they are being utilized efficiently

• Coordinate quality-control visits and project inspections

• Follow up on outstanding production issues until they are fully resolved

• Build and improve systems and processes that make production easier to manage and scale



A major part of this role will be recruiting and managing our subcontractor network. We do not view recruiting as something that should only happen when we urgently need additional workers. The Production Operations Manager should continuously develop relationships with qualified subcontractors so we have enough capacity as production volume changes throughout the year.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone with previous experience in operations, construction, home services, property management, logistics, dispatching, project coordination, or a similar environment.



The ideal candidate:



• Is extremely organized and detail-oriented

• Can manage many projects and moving pieces at the same time

• Is comfortable making decisions and solving problems independently

• Communicates extremely well in written and spoken English

• Is confident communicating with U.S. customers, contractors, and field workers

• Is comfortable holding people accountable

• Takes ownership of problems instead of waiting for someone else to solve them

• Can prioritize quickly when several issues happen at once

• Learns new software and systems quickly

• Is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where schedules can change

• Has experience working remotely for a U.S.-based company

• Has experience coordinating subcontractors, technicians, field crews, or other distributed workers

• Is looking for a long-term position with an opportunity to take on greater responsibility



We are specifically looking for someone who understands the difference between completing tasks and owning an outcome. You should be able to look at the entire production pipeline, determine what needs attention, communicate with the right people, and make sure things get done without requiring constant direction.



If we have projects starting next week, you should already be confirming subcontractor availability. If capacity is becoming tight, you should already be recruiting. If a customer or production issue develops, you should take ownership of getting it resolved. If the same type of problem keeps occurring, we want you to help improve the system so it stops happening.



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time, long-term position with a typical workload of approximately 40 hours per week. Some weeks may be lighter and others may require additional time depending on production volume and seasonality. Because you will be coordinating with U.S.-based customers, subcontractors, and field staff, you must be available primarily during U.S. Central Time business hours, approximately 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Time, Monday through Friday. This means working overnight hours in the Philippines, so please only apply if you are comfortable maintaining this schedule long term.



COMPENSATION



Compensation is $2,000–$2,500 USD per month depending on experience, ability, and fit. There is significant opportunity for increased compensation and responsibility for someone who performs well and becomes a key long-term member of the company.



TO APPLY



Please include the following with your application:



1. Begin your application with the words "I AM YOUR NEXT PRODUCTION MANAGER" so we know you carefully read the entire posting.

2. Briefly describe your experience managing operations, projects, contractors, logistics, or schedules.

3. Describe a situation where something went wrong operationally and explain how you handled it.

4. Tell us about your experience working U.S. business hours or overnight shifts.

5. Tell us about any experience you have managing or coordinating subcontractors, technicians, field crews, or other workers.

6. Include a short video introduction explaining your background and why you believe you would be a strong fit for this position.



Candidates who pass the initial application review will be invited to complete a practical operations exercise before moving forward in the hiring process.



We are looking for someone exceptional, dependable, proactive, and interested in becoming a long-term part of our company.

title: Chargeback Specialist — US Card Disputes for Fashion Dropshipping (proven win rate   required)
description:
We run several US-facing fashion stores on Shopify. Over the past period we have built hard on the

  backend of this operation, and we are targeting seven figures in revenue this Q4. We are building

  towards that right now.



  That is exactly why we need you. Growth on this scale brings disputes with it, and every

  chargeback we lose comes straight out of profit we already earned. We want one person who owns

  this completely, from the moment a dispute lands to the final decision, and who protects what we

  make.



  This is not a general VA role. If you have not personally fought and won US card disputes for

  fashion dropshipping stores, this is not for you.



  What you will do



  - Handle every chargeback across our stores, start to finish

  - Build the evidence package and write the response: order and delivery records, tracking,

    customer messages, payment data

  - Just as important, bring the number of chargebacks down. We want your recommendations on how we

    take payments, how we screen risky orders, and when we should refuse an order instead of

    shipping it. We expect you to push back on us when we are about to ship something we should

    cancel.



  What you must have



  - Hands on experience fighting US card chargebacks, and winning them

  - Experience in fashion dropshipping specifically, where goods ship from overseas suppliers and

    delivery takes weeks

  - A track record you can show us

  - Written English good enough that a bank will take your response seriously



  How to apply: read this carefully



  A word about AI. We use it ourselves and we do not mind if you use it to tidy up your English.

  What we will not read is a generic answer that could have been written about any store by anyone.

  We know this subject well, and we can tell within two lines whether you have actually fought a

  dispute or are repeating something you looked up an hour ago. If your application is all surface

  and no experience, we will see it.



  So write less, and make it yours.



  1. Put the word REPRESENTMENT in your subject line. That is how we know you read this post.



  2. Your CV, focused on fashion dropshipping. We want to see what you have done in fashion

  dropshipping: which stores or clients, in which years, what your role was, what you were

  responsible for. Name them. Other eCommerce and other industries can go at the bottom in a few

  lines. A general career CV with fashion dropshipping buried somewhere in it does not help us, and

  if there is no fashion dropshipping in it at all, this role is not for you.



  3. Your numbers. How many US disputes have you fought, how many did you win, over what period? And

  how do you know that number is right, where can you see it?



  4. Prove you are better at this than the other people applying. This is the most important part of

  your application. Show us anything real: screenshots of won cases, a dispute log, dashboard

  exports, before and after numbers from a store you worked on, a response letter you wrote, a

  reference who will confirm it. We would rather see one messy screenshot of a real case than a page

  of claims. Tell us plainly why you are the best person we will hear from this week, and back

  every sentence of it with something we can look at.



  5. This case. A customer orders a dress. It takes 18 days to arrive from our supplier. She never

 
s us. Three weeks after delivery her bank takes the money back and tells us she says she

  never authorized the payment, even though the tracking shows it was delivered to her address and

  she is the person who placed the order.



  Tell us, in plain language: what do you do, in what order, what evidence do you go looking for

  first, and how likely do you think we are to win this? If you think we will lose it, say so and

  tell us why. And tell us what you would have done differently before that order ever shipped.



  7. A video of 2 to 3 minutes, of yourself, talking us through your own application. Open what you

  wrote and explain your answers out loud, in your own words, without reading them. Tell us why you

  answered the case the way you did. We are not judging your English or your camera. We want to hear

  you think.



  If you can talk about your own application for three minutes without reading it, you wrote it.

  That is the whole point.



  What we offer



  We pay well for proven skill, and we will be open about the rate once we see your track record.

  This is a long term position on a growing operation. You work directly with the owner, with no

  agency in between, and what you save us is visible in the numbers every month.

title: Thumbnail Designer Disaster Documentary YouTube Channel
description:
Job Description:



We're building a disaster documentary channel and need a thumbnail designer who can build and maintain a consistent channel identity not just design one-off thumbnails that vary randomly by topic.



Reference examples of our exact style:

 • Bold/dramatic (Category A): "KRAKATOA IS AWAKE"  red hook text, mid eruption drama shot

 • Suspense (Category C): "2013 Oklahoma", "2011 Joplin" bold red year/place, ominous storm imagery

 • Restrained/respectful (Category B): "The Aberfan Disaster"  black and white tone, formal serif font, white text only, no red, no hype used only for tragedies with named victims



Core rules:

 • Every thumbnail must carry our consistent channel identity: same watermark placement, same signature design element (e.g. a consistent color grade or small recurring icon), same overall layout logic  regardless of topic

 • Within that identity, tone adjusts by category: Category A/C can be bold and red; Category B must stay restrained and respectful (see examples above)

 • One clear visual idea per thumbnail, with visible scale (small house/car/person next to the disaster) so danger reads instantly

 • Real photos by default  AI generated images never used for Category B

 • Max 2–4 words of text, max 2 colors  red only for Category A/C, never Category B

 • Must stay readable and "big and scary" even shrunk to mobile thumbnail size

You'll be doing:

 • Designing 1–2 thumbnail options per video based on the video's confirmed tone category, while keeping our consistent channel identity intact across every single one

 • Delivering source files (PSD or similar) for future edits



Requirements:

 • Portfolio showing bold, high contrast thumbnail design (disaster, true crime, or similar dramatic genres preferred)

 • Comfortable working from a detailed style guide and staying visually consistent across many thumbnails, even as topics change

 • Fast turnaround (24–48 hrs per thumbnail)

To apply, include:

 1. 3–5 thumbnail samples in a similar bold/dramatic style

 2. Your turnaround time per thumbnail

title: App Growth Marketer — Freelance / Part-Time
description:
App Growth Marketer — Freelance / Part-Time

SheepWorks · Remote · Flexible hours



About SheepWorks



SheepWorks Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore app studio focused on creating beautifully designed, highly functional and engaging digital experiences.



We believe good software should do more than simply work. It should feel intuitive, thoughtful and enjoyable to use. Our approach combines strong functionality with immersive design, playful interactions and a willingness to explore new ideas.



We build across everyday utilities, mental wellness, gamified experiences and other digital products where thoughtful design can make a meaningful difference.



Three values guide how we work:



- Integrity means building responsibly, being transparent in how we work, respecting user privacy and doing what we believe is right even when it is not the easiest option.

- Ownership means caring deeply about what we create, taking responsibility for outcomes and continuously improving the experiences we put into the world.

- Agility means staying curious, experimenting, learning quickly and adapting as technology, users and opportunities evolve.

- At SheepWorks, our goal is simple: create useful digital experiences that are thoughtfully made, beautifully designed and genuinely enjoyable to use.



Our direction



- Make it worth making. Start with a real need and create something useful. Every product, feature, and campaign should have a clear purpose.

- Strengthen the whole. Share ideas, learning, and capabilities so that good work in one part of SheepWorks helps the rest grow.

- Sweat the useful details. Care about the details that improve someone’s experience—from clear messaging to reliable delivery and thoughtful design.

- Earn the play. Build substance first, then bring creativity and humour. Our personality should make good work more memorable.

- Welcome people in. Be approachable, inclusive, and clear. High standards should make our products better for people and our team better to work with.



About the role



SheepWorks is looking for a hands-on freelance App Growth Marketer to help grow our mobile apps. You’ll work directly with the founder to plan, execute, and improve growth campaigns—from app discovery and installs to activation, retention, and paid conversion.



We’re looking for someone who can turn ideas into measurable experiments, work with a lean budget, and explain what’s working and what to try next.



What you’ll do



- Plan and execute growth. Develop a practical growth plan with clear priorities, budgets, and success metrics.

- Manage social publishing. Publish and schedule posts on relevant channels such as TikTok, Instagram, and LinkedIn, including uploading and organising assets supplied by our designer or content creator.

- Write marketing copy. Create captions, hooks, ad copy, and campaign messaging tailored to each audience and channel.

- Run paid acquisition. Set up, manage, and optimise campaigns across relevant platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Google App Campaigns, and Apple Search Ads.

- Test campaign performance. Test different audiences, creatives, messages, and budgets to identify what delivers meaningful results.

- Improve app store performance. Research and update ASO keywords and descriptions, brief visual improvements, and coordinate store-page tests.

- Lead growth experiments. Plan and coordinate tests involving landing pages, onboarding, pricing and paywalls, referral mechanics, and other growth opportunities, working with the founder, designer, and developer on implementation.

- Track the full user journey. Set up or review measurement with our developer and monitor performance from installs through activation, retention, and paid conversion.

- Make optimisation decisions. Recommend and execute decisions to stop, modify, or scale experiments within agreed budgets and approval boundaries.

- Report weekly. Provide a concise update on what was tested, what was spent, what worked, what didn’t, and what to do next.

- Explore additional growth channels. Identify relevant opportunities in organic growth, creator partnerships, and other acquisition channels.



What we’re looking for



- Strong Integrity, Ownership and Agility

- Demonstrated experience growing mobile apps, with examples of campaigns or experiments you personally managed.

- Hands-on experience with ASO and at least one major paid app acquisition channel.

- Understanding of app growth metrics such as cost per install, customer acquisition cost, activation, retention, lifetime value, and return on ad spend.

- Familiarity with tools such as Firebase, GA4, AppsFlyer, Adjust, App Store Connect, or Google Play Console.

- Ability to connect marketing performance to meaningful user and business outcomes.

- Strong written English, clear communication, and the ability to work independently.

- Comfort working with small budgets and prioritising the highest-impact opportunities.



You don’t need to be an expert in every channel. Tell us where you’re strongest and show us the results.



Engagement



- Freelance / part-time, fully remote.

- Flexible working hours, with agreed check-ins and deliverables.

- Initial paid engagement of 8 weeks, with potential to extend based on results and mutual agreement.

- Scope, hours, and compensation agreed based on experience and availability.



How to apply



Please send:



1. A brief introduction and a summary of your mobile app growth experience.

2. One or two relevant case studies explaining your role, the channels used, approximate budget, timeframe, and results. Anonymised examples are welcome.

3. The growth channels and tools you’re most confident using.

4. Your availability, time zone, and expected hourly or monthly rate.

5. A short answer: How would you approach your first 30 days growing an app with a limited budget?

title: Wedding Invitation Content Creator
description:
We are looking for a talented and creative person to create beautiful behind-the-scenes videos showing digital wedding invitation templates being put together on an iPad.



This is a long-term opportunity for someone who has a strong eye for design, understands aesthetics, and enjoys creating satisfying, premium-looking social media content.



The style and quality of content we are looking for is similar to:




/snowstarstudioco/


/urweddingbestie_org/


/studiohouseofv/



Please look through these pages before applying so you fully understand the type of videos, filming style and overall aesthetic we are looking for.



The invitation templates are already designed and built.



You will be provided with the finished design and all of the elements required, including:



- Images

- Graphics

- Fonts

- Colours

- Text

- Decorative elements

- Final design reference



You do not need to research or create every design from scratch.



Your main job is to take the provided elements and recreate the finished invitation on your iPad while filming the process beautifully.



The videos may show things such as:



- Moving elements into position

- Adding typography

- Adjusting text

- Adding photos

- Changing or adjusting colours

- Resizing elements

- Adjusting spacing

- Using the Apple Pencil

- Building the design piece by piece

- Showing the completed invitation at the end



We want the process to feel natural, satisfying and beautiful to watch.



A good understanding of wedding invitations and design is a big advantage.



We would love someone who understands:



- Good colour combinations

- Typography and font pairing

- Layout and spacing

- Visual hierarchy

- Wedding aesthetics

- Modern invitation styles

- Luxury, editorial and minimal design

- What currently looks attractive on Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest



Although the finished designs will already be provided, we want someone with a good eye who can notice when something could look better and help with small design decisions where needed.



If you are also capable of creating new invitation templates in the future, that is a big bonus and may lead to additional work.



FILMING SETUP



The filming setup is extremely important.



Before we move forward with your application, we want you to show us EXACTLY how you would set everything up if you got this job.



Please do not just send a random photo of your desk or equipment.



Actually prepare the full filming scene exactly as if you were about to record one of our videos.



We want to see:



- Exactly where the iPad would be positioned

- The exact camera angle you would use

- Where your hands would be

- How you would use the Apple Pencil

- Your desk or table

- Your full background

- The lighting

- Any props or decorative objects you would include

- How everything would be positioned inside the final video frame



Everything visible in the video should be well placed and intentional.



We are looking for:



- A clean and aesthetic background

- Beautiful lighting

- Good camera quality

- A professional camera angle

- A clean desk

- Well-positioned objects

- Good composition

- A premium overall look



We want to see exactly what the final videos would look like if you were hired.



HOW TO APPLY



When applying, please prepare the actual setup you would use for the job and send:



1. A photo showing the complete filming setup from the exact camera angle you would use.

2. A short video filmed from that exact setup so we can see the camera quality, lighting, background and overall aesthetic.

3. Show your iPad and Apple Pencil in the setup so we can see how the actual filming would look.

4. Tell us which iPad you use.

5. Tell us which phone or camera you use.

6. Send examples of your design work.

7. Send examples of any aesthetic videos or social media content you have created before.



We care a lot about attention to detail, taste and overall presentation.



You do not need to have a huge portfolio. If your setup looks beautiful and you clearly have a strong eye for design, we are interested.



TEST TASK



If we like your setup and application, you will move to the next stage.



Message me and I will send you the actual invitation elements and finished reference design for the test.



You will then recreate the supplied invitation on your iPad and film a short sample showing the process.



You will not need to invent a new design.



Everything required for the test will be provided.



We will mainly be looking at:



- Your filming setup

- Lighting

- Camera quality

- Background

- Composition

- Attention to detail

- How naturally you use the iPad and Apple Pencil

- Accuracy of the recreated design

- Overall aesthetic

- How satisfying and premium the final video feels



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



We are looking for someone we can work with long term.



If you are talented, reliable and consistently produce beautiful work, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility over time.



If you are also good at design, there may be additional opportunities to help create new invitation templates, improve existing designs and contribute your own creative ideas.



There is also an additional earning opportunity on top of the normal salary.



You will have the option to promote the product yourself through your own TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest or other social media accounts.



You can earn commission for every sale you personally generate.



The more sales you generate, the more you can earn.



This means someone who becomes very good at creating this type of wedding content can potentially earn significantly more on top of their normal pay.



The affiliate side is optional, but there is a big opportunity for someone who understands wedding content, social media and what customers like.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the business, improve their skills and potentially become an important part of the creative side of the company.





PAY & EARNING OPPORTUNITY



This role includes a guaranteed base payment of A$400 per month, plus the opportunity to earn significantly more through sales commissions.

description:
About the role



We are seeking an experienced Finance Controller to join GREENMACHINE SW LTD on a full-time basis. This is a strategic finance leadership position based in the United Kingdom, where you will take ownership of the financial accounting and reporting functions within our organisation. The Finance Controller plays a crucial role in ensuring accurate financial records, regulatory compliance, and providing meaningful financial insights to support business decision-making at all levels.



What you'll be doing





Overseeing the preparation and accuracy of financial statements in accordance with relevant accounting standards and regulatory requirements



Managing the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and month-end and year-end closing processes



Implementing and maintaining robust internal controls and financial policies to safeguard company assets



Leading and supervising the accounting team, providing guidance, training and performance management



Preparing detailed financial analysis, variance reports and management accounts to support strategic planning



Ensuring timely and accurate tax compliance, including corporation tax returns and VAT submissions



Developing and improving accounting processes and systems to enhance efficiency and reduce risk



Liaising with external auditors and managing the audit process



Providing financial advice and recommendations to senior management on business opportunities and cost control measures



Maintaining statutory records and ensuring compliance with Companies House and other regulatory requirements







What we're looking for





A professional accountancy qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) or substantial demonstrated experience in financial accounting and reporting



Minimum 5-7 years' experience in a Finance Controller, Senior Accountant or similar finance leadership role within a commercial organisation



Strong expertise in financial accounting, statutory reporting, and GAAP or IFRS principles



Proficiency with accounting software and systems, with experience in financial reporting tools



Advanced Excel skills and the ability to analyse complex financial data



Excellent knowledge of UK tax regulations, VAT, PAYE and corporate compliance requirements



Proven experience in leading and managing accounting teams effectively



Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines



Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex financial information for non-financial stakeholders



Integrity, reliability and a commitment to maintaining high ethical standards



Experience with payroll administration and pension scheme management (desirable)



Knowledge of sustainability reporting or ESG metrics (desirable)







What we offer



At GREENMACHINE SW LTD, we are committed to creating a supportive and engaging workplace where our employees can thrive. We offer competitive remuneration packages commensurate with experience, opportunities for professional development and continuous learning, flexible working arrangements where feasible to support work-life balance, access to employee wellbeing programmes and initiatives, and the chance to work with a dynamic team in a forward-thinking organisation. We value the contributions of all our employees and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse backgrounds and perspectives are welcomed and celebrated.



About us



GREENMACHINE SW LTD is a progressive organisation committed to delivering excellence in our field. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, innovative approach, and dedication to sustainable business practices. Our team is driven by a shared commitment to delivering quality results, supporting one another, and continuously improving our operations. We believe in investing in our people and providing them with the tools, training and support they need to succeed and develop their careers with us.



Apply now



If you believe you have the skills, experience and qualities we are looking for, we would welcome your application. Please submit your CV and a covering letter outlining why you are interested in this role and what you can bring to GREENMACHINE SW LTD.

title: Short-form Video Editor
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

BKG is a home-renovation group in the Netherlands. Our brands include Sanitairstudio (bathrooms) and

Tegelstudio (tiles), alongside 25+ other home-improvement brands in the wider BKG group. We film a lot of

short-form video ourselves and need an editor who turns that footage into videos people watch to the end.



JOB DESCRIPTION

You turn raw footage into Reels, TikToks and Shorts: a strong first two seconds, tight pacing, accurate captions

and light motion, in a consistent look per brand. One filming session of an hour should become 20 or more

clips. You work from the shoot guide and brief of our creative strategist, and our AI content creator supplies the

B-roll and visuals that were not filmed. Most of our videos are in Dutch; a Dutch colleague checks the captions

before anything is published. Your work is split across our bathroom brand (Sanitairstudio), the wider BKG

group and our tile brand (Tegelstudio), so you switch between brand looks.



MAJOR FUNCTIONS

Cut each filming session into 20 or more vertical clips, following the shoot guide: choose the moments, build

the hook, cut the dead air.

Edit for retention: the strongest moment first, tight pacing, and B-roll, zooms and on-screen text where they

help.

Add captions in our brand style, accurate and well timed. For Dutch videos you work with auto-transcription

and a glossary of our terms, and a Dutch colleague checks the captions before publishing.

Build and maintain the look per brand: caption template, title and lower-third animations, colors and export

presets.

Deliver versions: per platform (length, safe zones, cover frame) and ad variants with different hooks for our

Meta ads specialist.

Handle mixed footage: phone, pocket camera, 360° (reframing) and drone. Clean up the sound and match

the color.

Keep delivery reliable: an agreed delivery day per batch, clear file names, an organized archive and a B-roll

library. One round of feedback should be enough.



REQUIRED SKILLS

2+ years of short-form editing, with a portfolio you can link to.

BKG · Vacature 9 van 10 · Short-form Video Editor / Motion · 2 oktober 2026 1 / 4

A professional editor of your own (DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or Final Cut) next to CapCut. CapCut or

Canva alone is not enough for this role.

Strong pacing and hooks: you know what the first two seconds must do, and you can explain your choices.

Captions that are accurate, readable and timed to the speaker, and a clear process for captions in a

language you don’t speak.

Motion basics: animated titles, callouts and reusable templates.

Fast with AI-assisted tools (auto-captions, auto-clipping), and you know when to fix things by hand.

Clean sound, and you know which music a business account is allowed to use.

A computer that handles 4K footage and an internet connection that handles large files.

Reliable and responsive on your working days. Good written English.



TOOLS WE USE

Tell us which ones you have worked with.

CapCut, Submagic and Opus Clip: we provide these.

Your own DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or Final Cut. After Effects is a plus.

Insta360 Studio for reframing 360° footage.

Canva for cover frames.

A shared drive for footage; Bitrix24 for briefs and feedback.



NICE TO HAVE

Experience editing Dutch or other foreign-language video.

After Effects and motion templates.

Sound design and color grading.

Long-form YouTube or podcast editing.

Home, interior or real-estate content.

Knowledge of Dutch or German.



AVAILABILITY

Part-time, 20 hours per week, spread over at least four days, with daily responsiveness on those days. We

agree on a delivery day for each batch of footage. You have a weekly check-in with our content team during

Amsterdam business hours (CET/CEST), which is afternoon and evening in the Philippines. A reliable, highspeed internet connection is required.



EXPECTATIONS

You turn footage around quickly without dropping quality: tight pacing, clean captions, an on-brand finish. You

follow the brief, you say so when footage is unusable, and you can tell us why you made a cut. If you spot a

way to improve a process, a tool or a result, you raise it with your manager.



WORKING CONDITIONS / SALARY

$398/month. Part-time now, with room to grow as our content output scales. Long-term, stable role.



BONUSES

Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second

monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word “KEYFRAME” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these

four questions, 3 to 6 sentences each:

1. Name two short-form videos you edited and give the two links. A link to a folder or a full portfolio does not

count. For each: what you received (raw footage, brief) and what you did yourself.

2. Pick one of the two. Name one specific choice you made, with the timestamp (a cut, a caption timing, a

motion element), and why. Then name one thing you would do differently today.

BKG · Vacature 9 van 10 · Short-form Video Editor / Motion · 2 oktober 2026 2 / 4

3. Most of our videos are in Dutch and you don’t speak Dutch. How do you cut on meaning and get the

captions right? Give your steps, and say where a Dutch colleague comes in.

4. You receive one hour of raw footage from a single filming session, plus a shoot guide. We want 20 clips.

Describe your workflow and tools from download to delivery, and how many working hours you need.

Also include:

Your editing software and whether you have your own license, your computer (processor, RAM, graphics

card) and your internet speed.

Your usual turnaround for one 30 to 60 second short from raw footage, and which days and hours

(Philippine time) you are available.

We read every application that starts with the codeword and answers the questions specifically. Generic or

copy-paste replies aren’t considered.

title: Video editor for Meta ads and VSLs (full time, ongoing)
description:
I run a company called Qemoza. We make video ads for
 and Instagram. I need an editor to cut them.



This is a full time role, and it is ongoing.



The first step is a short paid trial. I pay for it whether or not I hire you.



WHAT YOU WOULD BE EDITING



Vertical video ads for Meta. About one to five minutes each.



Some longer VSLs as well. Those are horizontal, and they need motion graphics.



The raw footage is me talking to camera. You get the script with it.



HOW MUCH WORK THERE IS



About 25 ads a month, somewhere between 20 and 30, plus a VSL most weeks. It is full time work.



THE JOB



Turn that footage into an ad people watch.



A video might need motion graphics, text headlines that hit the direct points, b-roll to show an idea I am only saying, a clip pulled from a customer testimonial, music and sound effects.



Three things matter, in this order.



1. Clarity. Every point I make has to reach the viewer.

2. Professionalism. Every lead we get watches these videos, and it is the first time they meet us.

3. Engagement. It has to be easy to watch, and the first 5 seconds most of all.



WHAT I WANT TO SEE



- Video ads you have edited.

- Smooth, professional cuts with motion graphics.

- You reply the same working day.

- You work on your own. I give you the footage and a brief, not step by step instructions.

- You get work back to me quickly.



A bonus if you can make your own AI b-roll. We look for people who can.



THE TOOL



I will train you to edit with Claude Code. It strips the silences out of a cut and moves things around in seconds, and it saves a lot of time. You do not need to know it before you start. I teach it on the job. If you have used Claude already, say so.



PAY



The trial is paid by the hour, at the rate you tell me when you apply. It is capped at 2 hours and I pay it either way.



My budget for it is $15 to $25 per hour in USD.



Once we are working together I pay per ad, not by the hour. So how fast you get good at this is yours to keep.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here on OnlineJobs. Send a few ads you have cut, and your hourly rate in US dollars.



If it looks like a fit, I message you a short form, and then the paid trial.
salary: $15 to $25/hour trial, then paid per ad

Deliver B-roll clips and images to our video editor in the right format, on the agreed day.

Design carousels and infographics in Canva from the briefs of our creative strategist.

Draft the captions for those posts. Dutch text is drafted with AI and our templates, and a Dutch colleague

BONUSES

Paid Time Off after 1.5 months · salary reviews every 2–3 months · professional-development budget · second

monitor after 6 months · new laptop after 2 years.





HOW TO APPLY

Start your message with the word “INPAINT” so we know you have read the full post. Then answer these four

title: Video Editor
description:
About Nox Sleep



We're a premium sleep-optimization brand for high performers — athletes, founders, and ambitious people who treat their recovery as seriously as their training. We're building our content engine and need a skilled video editor to turn raw footage and our existing graphic designs into polished short-form Reels for Instagram and TikTok. You'll be the person who makes our content look like a real brand: clean, premium, and scroll-stopping.



What you'll do



You'll edit 8–12 vertical Reels per month (with room to grow) from assets we provide — raw footage, product clips, B-roll, music, and a brief for each one. Specifically:



Cut and assemble footage and B-roll into finished vertical Reels (9:16), and adapt to 4:5 and 1:1 when needed

Pace edits to music — cut on the beat, build rhythm, and hook the viewer in the first 3 seconds

Add clean, on-brand burned-in captions (most people watch on mute)

Color grade to our brand look — deep midnight-blue, cinematic, premium, and consistent across every video

Add text overlays, titles, and simple motion graphics in our brand style

Animate our existing infographics — we have a library of designed static graphics (sleep-science data visualizations) that we need animated into Reels: numbers counting up, charts drawing themselves in, text appearing in sequence. This is a key part of the role.

Export correctly for each platform, properly compressed, no quality loss



What we're looking for



Proven experience editing short-form vertical content (Instagram Reels / TikTok) — please show examples in your application

Strong motion-graphics skills — you can animate text, numbers, charts, and simple data visualizations, not just cut clips. This is essential.

Fluent in a professional editor — Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut (desktop/Pro)

A real eye for pacing, hooks, captions, and clean typography — you understand what makes a Reel actually perform, not just how to use the software

Able to match a consistent brand color grade across many videos

Fast, reliable turnaround (24–48 hours per Reel) and clear communication

Good written English — enough to follow briefs and give/receive feedback

Self-directed — you can take a brief and raw assets and deliver without needing hand-holding on every cut



Nice to have



Experience with health, fitness, wellness, or e-commerce/DTC brands

Ability to find and suggest licensed music and sound effects

Basic product/photo editing and retouching



How to apply



Please include:



Your portfolio or showreel — with short-form vertical Reels specifically (and any infographic/motion-graphics work you've done)

The editing software you use

Your typical turnaround time per Reel

To confirm you read this: start your application with the word "NIGHT SHIFT" at the top



Strong candidates will be asked to complete one paid test edit using our assets before we hire — this is how we'll see your speed, taste, and how you follow a brief.

title: Mobile Game Playtester / QA - Gold Below (iPhone or Android, Paid Trial)
description:
Help us improve Gold Below, a dark-fantasy loot roguelike for mobile.



We're looking for playtesters who can tell us what feels fun, confusing, frustrating or broken on a real iPhone or Android phone. This is a short paid testing gig. Clear observations and useful bug reports matter more than finding a large number of bugs.



PAID TRIAL AND RATE

The initial trial is up to two paid hours total, including setup, gameplay, screen recording and a short written report. Please quote your hourly rate in USD. We will agree on your rate, scope, start time and test access before you begin. Reporting time is paid and included in the two-hour limit. No unpaid test or game purchase is required. Further sessions may be offered, but ongoing hours are not guaranteed.



WHAT TO TEST

- Start fresh and tell us whether the goal, controls and first few decisions are clear.

- Try combat, inventory management, loot and upgrades. Note confusing labels, hard-to-read text or awkward touch controls.

- Check save/resume by closing and reopening the game and by moving it to the background.

- Note crashes, freezes, visual problems, lost progress or performance issues.

- Give honest feedback on difficulty, pacing and whether you want to keep playing.

- For each bug, include the phone model, OS and game version, steps to reproduce, expected versus actual behavior, and a screenshot or video timestamp when possible.

REQUIREMENTS

- Ability to record the phone screen with microphone audio.

- Clear written and spoken English for feedback.

- Familiarity with mobile games. Roguelike or turn-based game experience and previous QA work are useful but not essential for thoughtful playtesting.

- A stable connection to download the build and share your recording.



TO APPLY

Use the subject: Gold Below Playtester

1. List your phone model(s), OS version(s), and available screen-recording method.

2. State your hourly rate in USD and availability for a two-hour trial.

3. Briefly describe your testing experience and name two games you play, including what you like or dislike about them.

4. If you already have a bug report or narrated testing sample, share it. Do not create new unpaid work to apply.



We want candid product feedback; no public store review or positive rating is requested.

title: Digital Marketing Ads Specialist

, message and video call

You'll play a direct role in client success and retention, which is why this role includes performance-based earning potential.



How You'll Earn

Base Salary: AUD $2,200/month 



Why Join Maximize Marketing?

We're a growing agency built on one simple philosophy: great people should be trusted to do great work.

What that means for you:
